articleTitle: Thyroid Detection and Interpretation using XAI (eXplanable Artificial Intelligence)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: We have designed this machine learning model in order to help the victims of thyroid suffering from its chronic effects. In our machine learning model we will be using various classification algorithms like KNN(K-nearest neighbours) classifiers, random forest classifier, Naive bayes classifier, random forest classifier, SVM(support vector machines) and decision trees. Among all the above classification algorithms random forest have produced more accurate results. We will be taking the data of different patients from the laboratories and convert into. csv file. We will train the model using the above algorithms and the performance of the model is calculated on the basis of Accuracy, Precision, Recall and F1-Score. In our paper we will be using explainable AI (XAI) to explain the results and output produced by our model. There are several methods and processes in the field of XAI, here we are using an open source python library called SHAP(shapely additive explanations). The main advantage of SHAP is that it will help the user to understand which feature is most influential in the model.

articleTitle: Predicting Employee Churn- Data Driven Approach for Retention Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Employee churn is a critical challenge faced by organizations across industries, leading to disruptions in productivity and increased costs associated with recruitment and training. In this study, we propose an effective solution leveraging Random Forests to predict employee churn accurately and efficiently. Our approach addresses the inherent complexities of employee turnover prediction while considering resource constraints commonly encountered in practical applications. The proposed model incorporates feature engineering techniques and ensemble learning principles to harness the predictive power of Random Forests. Through a comprehensive evaluation on real-world employee datasets, we demonstrate the superior performance of our model in comparison to existing state-of-the-art methods. Our analysis encompasses various evaluation metrics, including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, showcasing the robustness and reliability of our model across diverse organizational contexts.

articleTitle: Leveraging IEEE 802.11 Network Proximity Detection for Device-Based Authentication and Latency-Optimized Presence Logging in Institutional Attendance Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In modern educational institutions, accurately tracking student attendance is essential. This study proposes an innovative Wi-Fi Attendance System that automates the process of marking attendance based on students' connection to the institution's Wi-Fi network. The system prompts students to register by entering their preferred user ID and password upon connecting to the Wi-Fi, storing their information along with their device's IP address. Subsequent connections are authenticated by matching the user ID and IP address, marking students as present, absent, or missing. Rigorous testing evaluates system performance, emphasizing reliability and efficiency. This system reduces manual effort and enhances attendance accuracy, contributing to streamlined administrative processes in educational settings.

articleTitle: Improving Cotton Leaf Disease Detection with MobileNetV2: An Analysis in Comaparison with MobileNetV3-Small
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Cotton leaf diseases need to be recognized and categorized in order to improve cotton production and guarantee high-quality yields. The increasing impact of climate change on disease transmission requires the use of accurate and effective early detection methods. This study compares the performance of two compact convolutional neural networks, MobileNetV2 and MobileNetV3Small, in identifying cotton leaf illnesses. While MobileNetV3Small shows an accuracy of 0.75, whereas MobileNetV2 attains an accuracy of 0.99. This significant distinction highlights MobileNetV2 has improved ability to discriminate between healthy and diseased leaves, making it an essential tool for practical and scalable application in accurate farming. According to these findings, MobileNetV2 can provide quick interventions, the prevention of disease, and an overall rise in cotton yield.

articleTitle: Semi Autonomous Seeding BOT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This semi-autonomous agricultural robot enhances precision farming by integrating sensors and automation. It uses a servo-controlled seeding mechanism for accurate seed placement based on soil moisture levels, ensuring optimal planting conditions. A temperature sensor monitors environmental factors critical for germination, while an ultrasonic sensor detects obstacles for uninterrupted operation. An ESP 32 CAM module captures real- time images for crop health monitoring, enabling early detection of issues. The robot's combination of autonomous seeding, environmental sensing, and crop monitoring aims to improve efficiency, optimize resource use, and support sustainable farming practices.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of 8th Order ECG Filter Design with Optimizing Performance Truncated Multipliers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The purpose of the research is to develop and execute the finite and infinite impulse response digital filters based on the field programmable gate arrays with the aid of the Xilinx ISE design software application package. Often, low pass digital filters are implemented for various medical applications for quick issue detection and prediction. In particular, accurate heart rate predictions are obtained through the real-time processing of ECG signals and thus these filters have to be of high efficiency, low logic size parameters and low power consumption. This work aims to present a comparison and some analysis of FIR and IIR filters. To reduce logic size, a truncated multiplier is applied and its performance is evaluated against conventional methods. For signal accuracy, the FIR filter is designed using the Rectangular Window method where the IIR filter is designed using the Direct Form II Chebyshev Type II method both utilizing an eighth order design. The implementation is carried out using Xilinx ISE Design Suite. The performance is measured by the difference between the ECG signal in simulation and the actual measured signal. The utilization of FPGA with digital filters in this research presents numerous merits.

articleTitle: DDoS Attack Detection Using Deep-Learning Tool with Fused Features and Random Forest Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Recently, a number of attempts and methodologies are created by the attacker to interrupt industry, disturb the significant infrastructures, and online services in order to create financial losses, and reputational damage. The Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attack is a common practice which aims to disturb a target server or a network by flooding it with excessive traffic with the help of botnet. When it is detected appropriately, necessary measures can be taken to reduce its impact. This study proposes a Deep-Learning (DL) tool to accurately detect the DDoS. The stages in the proposed scheme includes; data collection and resizing, implementing the chosen DL-scheme to extract the features, identification of the best DL-model for the chosen data and reducing its features using 50% dropout, feature-fusion (FF) and classification with three-fold cross-validation. The proposed DL-tool is verified using the FF with chosen classifiers and this approach help to achieve a DDoS detection accuracy of 100% when the Random Forest (RF) classifier based detection is implemented.

articleTitle: Tomato Leaves Disease Detection Using Gray Level Co-Occurrence Matrix (GLCM) and Image Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Crop diseases pose a serious danger to agricultural productivity and food security, making accurate detection techniques urgently needed. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) are used in this project's automated approach to better detect damaged tomato leaves using image processing. First, a sizable dataset with tagged photos of both healthy and diseased leaves is gathered from sources such as the Plant Village collection. To increase the diversity and quality of data, preprocessing techniques like data augmentation, scaling, and standardization are used. To guarantee accuracy and robustness, the CNN model is trained on well-labeled datasets after extracting complex features from the images. Techniques like batch normalization and dropout help reduce overfitting. Metrics including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score are used to evaluate the model's performance, showing significant improvements over conventional methods. With potential for wider uses in precision farming, the findings show that CNNs are a viable tool for the early and precise diagnosis of tomato leaf diseases. In order to enhance performance across a range of crops and diseases, future research will concentrate on transfer learning and growing datasets. The proposed model achieved 97.2% ACC, 95.7% Spec, 94.5% Recall, 98% Prec, and 97.5% F1-Score.

articleTitle: AI Enhanced Anomaly Detection of System Logs in Cyber Security
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The detection of anomalies in log data is essential for safeguarding digital infrastructures, as it helps identify irregularities that could signal potential security threats. As the complexity and volume of log data grow, Security Operations Center (SOC) analysts encounter mounting difficulties in quickly and effectively identifying and responding to incidents. This paper reviews advanced log anomaly detection techniques that employ AI technologies, with a specific focus on the Isolation Forest Algorithm. We delve into the integration of Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools, pivoting techniques, process tree analysis, and summarization methods to enhance the identification and interpretation of suspicious activities. The paper discusses the development and examination of process trees, aiming to equip SOC analysts with practical insights and recommendations. Additionally, we assess how AI-powered log analysis can overcome existing challenges and improve the detection of complex threats. Finally, we summarize our key findings and propose future research avenues to address ongoing challenges in log anomaly detection.

articleTitle: CSPS- Cyber Security Physical System with a Gaming and Defence Strategic Approach to Detect the Malicious Attack for Vehicle to Everything Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Cyber is the word that relates to computer, network and virtual reality. And providing security for these types of system is called cyber security. And this paper discusses about cyber security physical system which is the integration of both hardware and software as there is a possibility of malicious attacks on hardware too because of intervention of IoT devices, where because of these malicious attacks can consume energy of the system or changes the commands for the malfunctioning and everything need to be tracked. The major difference between Cyber security and cyber security physical system is that cyber security is meant for restricting unauthorized access of electronic data and cyber physical security system aims in securing both data as well as IoT devices and other hardware devices from malicious attacks. Cyber security physical system (CSPS) together provides a network, Application, Infrastructure, and IoT security as well as surveillance, access control and testing. The proposed method finds the expected time of failure, malicious attacks on both hardware and software and based on the training. The CSPS system the system able to differentiate the normal command and the command from the attackers, so whenever the doubt arises the CSPS makes those command to wait and if it is secured the command will be executed with a delay or else it will be discarded which protects the system from any types of attackers. And also, the system aims in achieving the higher efficiency through a smaller number of IoTs devices, and also it aims to combinedly use gaming approach, defence strategy with a security supervisor approach to differentiate between the defender and attacker which proves its own efficiency.

articleTitle: Geospatial Technology and IoT Based Soil and Water Consevation - A Critical Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The health of ecosystems and the availability of food are seriously threatened by soil deterioration. Conventional conservation techniques frequently depend on human monitoring, which causes resource allocation to be inefficient and delays interventions. The potential of sensor technology to maximize soil conservation efforts is investigated in this work. To track temperature, pH, nutrient levels, and soil moisture in real time, a network of wireless sensors was installed. To find patterns, spot abnormalities, and forecast the likelihood of soil erosion, data analytics and machine learning algorithms were used. Global water security is also threatened by water scarcity and wasteful use. Estimated measures are frequently used in traditional conservation procedures, which wastes resources. A sensor-based system for real-time water management and monitoring is presented in this paper. A wireless sensor network monitors the Leak detection, pH, turbidity, conductivity, pressure, and water flow rates Advanced algorithms for machine learning and data analytics are Recognize patterns and irregularities, estimate water use, Find leaks and unauthorized use, Improve the distribution of water. This sensor-based strategy makes possible, Monitoring and decision-making in real-time, data-driven conservation tactics, Enhanced effectiveness of resources, Cost-effective and scalable implementation.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Innovative Police Complaint Management System Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Law enforcement organizations have considerable obstacles in addressing police complaints including misclassification sluggish response times and a lack of openness this paper introduces a novel police complaint handling system that combines blockchain technology for safe and transparent case management with machine learning ml for complaint categorization and prediction the technology classifies complaints according to severity urgency and importance by using sophisticated machine learning algorithms which enables more rapid and precise responses by generating an unchangeable ledger of complaint records and thwarting manipulation blockchain technology guarantees data integrity by automating tasks like officer assignments and case updates smart contracts minimize human error and the need for manual intervention the method also enables citizens to monitor the progress of their concerns in real-time encouraging openness.

articleTitle: Game-Based Learning Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Students are introduced to newer technologies and so are the professionals, in order to be in the top of their game, students and working professionals alike are in a dire need to update themselves. articleTitle: Enhanced Surveillance Abilities Through Object Detection in Autonomous Robots
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The system emphasizes the operation of an autonomous environment monitoring robot with the capability of object detection and tracking using OpenCV and mobile application, we gather real-time video data from the environment with the help of an ESP-32 cam module and cast the data to the respective mobile application forum for the visualization and analysis of the surrounding space with the help of WIFI (wireless fidelity). We use an ESP-32 camera-based autonomous surveillance robot integrated with a camera and ESP-32 microcontroller for real-time object detection using OpenCV with the help of pretrained models like mobile net, tensor flow, etc. The ESP-32 cam module processes images controls motors for movement and communicates wirelessly for security applications offering a versatile solution for tracking and monitoring operations.

articleTitle: Secure Web Authentication Using Visual Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Today password based authentication is seemingly more vulnerable than before because of the rising advancements in cyber attack techniques, user's tendencies to keep a simple weak password in order to remember them and more reasons. Also given the fact that password based authentication are the most user friendly method available and users tend to prefer seeing them over other methods, This paper proposes a pre-authentication single sign on step with regular re-authentication before the actual website's login forms are visible to the user through the use of google extension. The concept of visual cryptography can be utilised to split an image into multiple shares, and all these shares are required to reconstruct the original image. This technique can be utilised for the proposed secure web authentication. To be more specific of the paper's methodology. Naor Shamir's (2,2) visual cryptography scheme is implemented here for the pre-authentication mechanism. A user holds one image share while the server holds the other and the comparison of the original image and the reconstructed original image from the two shares authenticates the user and redirects to the webpage's actual login. Hence removing the idea of an attack getting direct access to the login forms initiating various attacks.

articleTitle: DAI-BO Integrated Intelligent Lens Beamforming for Dynamic 5G Network Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This study introduces the DIA-BO (DAI-Beam Optimization) 5G Algorithm tailored for the optimization of 5G network coverage within dynamic device-to-device environments. The algorithm seamlessly integrates lens-based beamforming with the Distributed Artificial Intelligence Solution (DAIS) framework. Specifically crafted for 5G networks, the algorithm leverages lens beamforming to focus radio signals, enhancing coverage and transmission efficiency. DAI-BO adapts the DAIS planning mechanism to accommodate lens beamforming characteristics. Employing Belief-Desire-Intention (BDIx) agents with fuzzy logic, the algorithm optimizes transmission mode selection to maximize spectral efficiency and minimize power consumption. Its adaptability to dynamically changing network topologies resulting from user mobility is demonstrated through extensive evaluations under various simulation conditions involving mobile user attributes. Comparative performance assessments against alternative approaches involve modeling scenarios with parameter variations, including user speed, transmission power levels, and device densities. The analysis affirms the algorithm's prowess in maintaining optimal coverage across intricate 5G environments by efficiently adapting to dynamic conditions. This research underscores the advantages of intelligently applying lens beamforming, optimized by the DAI- BO 5G Algorithm, to dynamically enhance 5G network coverage using artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Fuzzy-Based Routing Scheme with Reliable Transmission Enhanced by Deep Learning for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The advent of fifth-generation (5G) communication technologies is set to transform the global Internet of Everything (IoE) by linking numerous physical devices to the Internet. This extensive connectivity plays a vital role in IoT applications such as smart homes, city management, transportation, surveillance and the Internet of Medical Things (IoMT). Although wireless communication seeks to achieve broader coverage, lower latency, higher throughput, and increased reliability, challenges remain in optimizing limited communication resources and enhancing coding, modulation, and channel estimation methods. Managing transmission power is essential for mitigating interference and conserving energy. Our study introduces a fuzzy logic optimization routing (FLOR) method designed to extend the lifespan of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) by making routing decisions based on nodes' energy levels and network distances. We evaluate FLOR's performance against current methods, showing the significant improvements in throughput, packet delivery ratio, average end-to-end delay and normalized routing overhead. In addition a deep learning-based strategy is proposed for sub-band assignment and power control in IoT cellular networks. Utilizing the convolutional neural networks (CNNs), we enhance the resource allocation, decrease latency, and improve energy efficiency. Our results demonstrate that deep learning methods outperform traditional techniques, offering faster speeds, reduced latency, and better energy efficiency. The integration of deep learning with edge computing and network slicing further benefits various IoT applications, boosting network performance, reliability, and energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Reinforced Learning Model with Coati optimization Algorithm for Energy Efficient Routing for WSN Connecting IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The emergence of notable obstacles such heterogeneity, dependability, and scalability has been brought about by the growth of varied wireless devices in real-time Internet of Things applications. A new architecture known as Energy-Efficient Routing for IoT (EER-IoT) has been designed to efficiently address these problems. IoT devices in these systems, however, have to deal with unpredictable network dynamics, energy limitations, and strict quality of service requirements. The importance of having a well-designed routing protocol is highlighted by these reasons. Inaction on this part frequently results in frequent network disconnections and poor performance. In this work, we offer the intelligent, energy-efficient routing protocol, called EER-COA-RL, that combines reinforcement learning with the Coati Optimization Algorithm. This protocol evaluates fitness functions based on residual energy (RER) and distance limitations in an effort to improve network performance and lifespan. Optimizing energy usage in Internet of Things networks is the main goal of implementing this routing method. This is especially important since wireless Internet of Things devices have limited energy resources and you need to be able to quickly adjust to changes in the network to minimize interruptions and maximize network performance.

articleTitle: Real Time Lung Cancer Prediction Using Lazy Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The lungs are vital organs responsible for oxygenating the body and filtering out harmful substances. The main causes for lung cancer are smoking, Alcohol use and Air pollution. Lung cancer is crucial for improving patient predicting and reducing mortality rate. The mortality rate from lung cancer continues to rise across all age groups. The primary objective is to evaluate the effectiveness of these algorithms in early lung cancer detection which improves the patient survival rates. Machine learning revolutionizes health care by facilitating early disease detection through robust data analysis techniques. This study utilizes supervised machine learning algorithms, including Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression and also K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), to identify early stages of lung cancer risk. Among the tested models, Logistic Regression and also K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) has the highest accuracy, achieving an accuracy rate of 99.99%. This models achieves highest performance and evaluated based on precision, recall, accuracy and area under the curve.

articleTitle: An Improved Multiscale Faster R-CNN Based Lung Cancer Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Lung cancer is a leading cause of cancer-related deaths, making early and accurate detection crucial. This project develops an automated detection system using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) to improve the identification of malignant nodules in lung CT scans. The process involves collecting a large dataset from public repositories, followed by preprocessing steps like normalization and augmentation to enhance input quality. The CNN architecture is designed to capture complex features of lung nodules, with training on expertly annotated data. Techniques such as dropout and batch normalization are used to prevent overfitting. The model's performance is evaluated using metrics like accuracy and ROC curve analysis, showing significant improvement over traditional methods. The findings suggest that CNNs offer a promising approach to early and accurate lung cancer detection, with potential for clinical application and future integration with other diagnostic tools. At the stage of diagnosis our major aim is to reach the higher level accuracy and efficiency. The improved model, based on lung cancer increases the performance, by combining the properties of various network structures. The proposed model achieved 96.2 % ACC, 94.7% Spec, 93.5% Recall, 98% Prec, and 98.5 % F1-Score. In addition to helping medical professionals with patient care and monitoring, the enhanced model may more accurately detect lung cancer, lower the possibility of incorrect and delayed diagnoses resulting from physician personal reasons, and enhance the overall evaluation and treatment process.

articleTitle: Advancing Glaucoma Detection: Synthetic Image Generation via Generative Adversarial Networks and Classification with Pretrained MobileNetV2
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Irreversible vision loss, generally insidious in start and lacking apparent symptoms, is usually attributed to glaucoma. Detecting glaucoma in its early stages is crucial since it may reduce disease progression. Conventional diagnostic approaches, depending on manual assessments, are notably prone to mistakes. Hence, automated glaucoma analysis acquires vital relevance for precise and prompt detection. Moreover, medical picture databases frequently display asymmetries, creating a problem. To solve these challenges, this paper presents a unique framework employing generative adversarial networks (GANs) to generate images, thus addressing dataset imbalances. Specifically., in the context of fundus images, standard approaches like image-to-image translation are applied to build synthetic fundus images and associated vascular networks, attempting to boost overall image quality and capture finer details. Gaussian filtering is originally done to pre-process the raw dataset, eliminating unwanted noise. Subsequently, GANs are applied for dataset balancing, providing synthetic images that boost classification accuracy. Optic cup segmentation is conducted using the Enhanced Level Set Algorithm. Finally, Pretrained MobileNetV2 permits accurate classification of glaucomatous images into normal and pathological categories. Experimental results illustrate the efficacy of our suggested framework, obtaining an accuracy of 98.9%, exceeding existing techniques.

articleTitle: SEPIC Converter Design and Implementation for EV Battery Charger with Multiple Output System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) are gaining popularity due to their energy efficiency and low carbon emissions. However, the limited charging infrastructure poses a significant barrier to their widespread adoption. To tackle this challenge, developing effective and affordable EV chargers that support various battery voltages is essential. This study introduces a multi-voltage charger circuit utilizing a non-inverting DC-DC converter known as a SEPIC (Single-Ended Primary Inductor Converter). This converter can both step up and step down input voltage, accommodating batteries with different requirements, such as 24V, 36V, and 48V. A SEPIC-based charger enhances EV charging accessibility and promotes faster adoption of electric vehicles, ultimately aiding in reducing carbon emissions

articleTitle: Integrating CNN and Random Forest Algorithm for Multi Satellite Image Compression in Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: At the moment, scholarly attention is being drawn to a significant issue called multispectral image compression (MSIC). Radar systems, satellite communications, and sensing technologies are always keeping an eye on the environment, space, and Earth. Resources like power consumption and storage are becoming more and more affordable in the competitive marketplace. Moreover, performance capability is still limited. Multispectral image processing is required during this process. The methods and the conditions for using them must be followed. Satellite cameras keep an eye on related optical data, water wells, disaster surveillance, and geographic information. Machine learning statistical parameters, attacks, histogram equalisation, and compression of image quality all require improvements. Existing approaches mostly use low-rank tensor decomposition, DWT segmentation methods, and matrix-based modeling; nevertheless, they fail to distinguish between different strip components and have several drawbacks. Moreover, problems with spectral redundancy and the removal of sub-band models can be resolved using machine learning. The Natural Random Forest Machine Learning Model (NRFML) is utilized in this study. This model trains and compresses multispectral images for a variety of uses. In the end, it contrasts MSE, PSNR, NCC, and SSIM metrics with current techniques and finds that the proposed NRFML is competitive with past methods.

articleTitle: Rover Based Early Warning System for Plant Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This project presents an autonomous rover designed to detect wheat diseases in real time using machine learning. A CNN model was developed in MATLAB for accurate disease identification from images captured by the ESP32 Cam on the rover. The system integrates multiple sensors, including ultrasonic sensors for obstacle avoidance and soil moisture sensors for environmental monitoring. Powered by an onboard battery and controlled by a microcontroller, the rover navigates fields autonomously, reducing manual labor and enhancing precision agriculture. This solution promotes sustainable farming by improving crop management and minimizing yield loss.

articleTitle: AI-Based Indian Currency Detection for Visually Challenged Users
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: For denomination recognition, this Indian Currency Detection System will use a CNN trained on an extremely large and diverse set of Indian banknotes from $$ 10 to $$ 2000. It possesses an amicable interface through which images can be captured using the camera of the user's smartphone, providing real-time audio feedback to denominate the banknote without requiring any visual assistance. Made with the features of capturing an image, real-time recognition, and user-friendly design, these are made to add a great experience for smooth navigation by a blind person. The novel and innovative features make this Indian Currency Detection System unique. Using CNN, which has been trained on the comprehensive set of Indian banknotes from $$10 to $$2000, the software lets a user capture banknote image directly by the smartphone camera. It allows knowing the denomination through real-time audio feedback without any visual assistance. Such characteristics include image capture, real-time identification, and designing user-friendly user interfaces that make easy navigation of the surroundings possible for the visually impaired. It does more than detect currency. It significantly contributes to the discussion regarding the development and availability of more assistive technologies. It is usable and aims to bring about greater accessibility and inclusivity in promoting financial independence among visually impaired people. Contributing to the ability of cash transactions among the visually impaired to gain confidence in freedom and security, this project aligns with a broader discussion related to assistive technologies.

articleTitle: Design of MEMS Thermocouple with Chromel and Alumel (Cr-Al)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The design, simulation, and analysis of a MEMS-based thermocouple sensor utilizing Chromel (Cr) and Alumel (AI) materials, forming a Type K thermocouple known for its accuracy and stability in extreme temperature environments. The MEMS approach offers advantages such as miniaturization, rapid thermal response, and enhanced sensitivity, making the device suitable for applications requiring precise temperature measurement in challenging conditions. The thermocouple generates a Seebeck voltage proportional to the temperature difference between its hot and cold junctions. Simulation results using Ansys demonstrate the sensor's effectiveness. The temperature distribution indicates a significant thermal gradient, ranging from -200°C at the cold junction to a maximum of 1372°C at the hot junction, suggesting strong thermoelectric voltage generation potential. The total electric field intensity reaches a maximum of 1492.1 V/m, reflecting efficient charge separation and movement in response to the thermal gradient. The X-axis directional electric field intensity peaks at 49.427 V/m, showing localized regions of charge carrier concentration that are crucial for the sensor's functionality. The MEMS-based thermocouple shows excellent thermal and electrical response characteristics, making it ideal for high-performance temperature sensing in industrial, biomedical, and environmental applications.

articleTitle: Dynamic Payback Period Estimation for Solar Power Plants Through ML Based Solar Power Generation Forecasts
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Substantial capital is required to invest in solar power plants, which puts estimation of the payback period accurately at primary concern for stakeholders. In this paper, we proposed a novel method to estimate the payback period of a 10MW solar power plant through forecasting solar power generation by an optimized XGBoost Machine learning model. We began by forecasting the Global Horizontal Irradiance (GHI) and temperature with a temporal resolution of 1 hour for the upcoming year. Using these forecasted values, the expected power output of a single solar panel with given properties is calculated, which was further scaled for the entire plant to estimate the total power generated for entire year with a resolution of 1 hour. Monthly income from the plant is estimated by considering current electricity prices and the predicted power of each month. Plant investments accounted for various costs, including panels, land acquisition, maintenance, wiring, and equipment, while also considering compound interest on the initial investment (compounded monthly) with monthly loan repayments. By considering different scenarios, we determined the payback period by varying factors such as interest rates, land costs, panel efficiency, and maintenance expenses. Our findings offer offer valuable insights into the financial feasibility and potentiality of solar power plants and demonstrate how these factors influence the payback period of such plants.

articleTitle: Design and Development of SPP for Enhanced OAM Beam Performance with High Mode Purity
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This work describes the design and analysis of a conical horn antenna that incorporates spiral phase plates (SPP) for producing orbital angular momentum (OAM) beams at Wi-Fi frequencies around 2.4 GHz. The antenna system's performance is determined using SPPs made of different dielectric materials, such as Rogers, polylactic acid (PLA), and FR4. The simulation results show that the suggested design successfully creates OAM beams across all evaluated dielectric materials. However, raising the dielectric constant causes impedance mismatches, which remain within tolerable ranges. The study emphasises the importance of dielectric material selection in achieving optimal impedance matching and system efficiency while still producing hiah-quality OAM waves.

articleTitle: Phishing Site Detection using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Phishing web sites are a big cybersecurity threat, frequently serving as access factors for assaults that compromise facts confidentiality and integrity. This studies proposes a gadget getting to know-primarily based totally method to discover phishing webweb sites via way of means of extracting and reading capabilities from URLs and internet site content. By leveraging algorithms inclusive of choice bushes and deep neural networks, this version is skilled to become aware of phishing styles on categorized datasets. To deal with facts imbalance and beautify version performance, oversampling and ensemble getting to know strategies are applied. Explainable AI techniques enhance interpretability, presenting insights into detection processes. The version is evaluated the use of real-international datasets, displaying better accuracy and robustness in comparison to present techniques. This method holds promise for advancing phishing detection, important for countering cyber threats and improving on line security. Continued studies is vital to live in advance of evolving phishing tactics.

articleTitle: Upgraded Transcribed Digit Acknowledgment with CNN Patterns and Future Headings
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Transcribed digit acknowledgment is an imperative area of exploration in artificial intelligence and machine learning, with huge applications in document analysis, postal automation, banking, and education. This study investigates the implementation of a deep learning based approach to recognize handwritten digits from the MNIST dataset, which contains 70,000 grayscale images of digits (0–9). The essential goal is to design, develop, and evaluate a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) capable of accurately classifying transcribed digits. The CNN architecture was constructed using TensorFlow and incorporates convolutional layers for feature extraction and max-pooling layers for dimensionality reduction.

Author Keywords: Modified National Institute of Standards and Technology

articleTitle: Advanced Braille Based Communication System Using Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Our paper focuses on assistive technology based on human-computer interaction principles providing simultaneously that products are user-friendly and meet specific user needs. Accessibility engineering, or designing and developing technology accessible to people with different abilities and usable by them, is another very important point here. Frequently, this field requires interdisciplinary collaboration among engineers, designers, therapists, and end-users in the development of effective, practical solutions. The idea of this project is based upon the smartphone-based solution for the varied kinds of problems that people with vision disabilities face. Before a solution or tool for the blind moves forward, the needs of the target group must be analyzed. This was by considering the fact that smartphones are highly accessible, and developers just overlook it in creating a solution to aid the visually impaired in their issues using the capabilities of the smartphone. The approach that is proposed will give an abstraction layer above the OS and will have many functionalities that allow it to co-act with a blind user-it also gives a user interface.

Author Keywords: Natural language processing (NLP)voice response and Braille code

articleTitle: Florasense: Adaptive Plant Health & Growth Advisor
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This paper presents Florasense: Adaptive Plant Health & Growth Advisor, a cutting-edge system that uses artificial intelligence (AI) and Internet of Things (IoT) technologies for thorough plant health monitoring and automated care in response to the growing demand for precision agriculture and sustainable plant care. In order to analyze plant leaf photos and enable real-time nutrient assessment and early illness detection, Florasense uses Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Reinforcement Learning algorithms. This AI-powered method reduces resource waste and allows for prompt action by offering adaptive insights about plant health. Florasense incorporates an automated irrigation system that kicks off when soil moisture falls below ideal levels and continuously monitors environmental factors like temperature and humidity. Florasense provides real-time updates on plant health, nutrient levels, and ambient variables via an intuitive mobile application.

articleTitle: DynaShield:Android Malware Detection Using Dynamic Analysis of Network Traffic
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In an era where mobile applications are integral to daily life, safeguarding Android devices from malicious threats has become a paramount concern. This project addresses the pressing issue of Android malware detection by developing a robust detection system that leverages diverse datasets and advanced machine learning techniques. By incorporating permission-based, network traffic-based, API call-based, opcode-based, system call-based, binary-based, and behavior-based datasets, our approach aims to provide a comprehensive and accurate detection mechanism. Through rigorous evaluation using metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, we aim to achieve a system that not only identifies known malware but also uncovers previously unseen threats. This paper presents the methodology, implementation, and performance analysis of the proposed system, offering valuable insights into the future of mobile security.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis by High Torque to Weight Ratio for Cage Type Induction Motor Cost Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The most common stack in transportation frameworks is Cross- breed vehicles, Footing, and propeller engines. Nowadays, crossover vehicles are the subject of the majority of inquiries. Thinking about the toll viability, efficacy, and quality of acceptance engine execution is important. The engine's weight is minimal for transporting purposes, and the torque should essentially be high for the motor's operation. In electric cross- breed vehicles, torque and weight proportion are two of the most important factors. Using a restricted component strategy (FEM) of a three-stage acceptance engine, this extension evaluates the excellent plan with optimization, torque, and weight proportion of four arrangement strategies. It takes a toll estimation of each setup. Every setup requires a toll estimation. Here, we have substituted copper and aluminum with unique configurations for the rotor bar and end ring materials. By using these configurations, we have seen the disadvantages of an acceptance machine in terms of weight, fabric, productivity, and misfortunes.

Author Keywords: material cost of an induction motor

articleTitle: Women Safety Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Women's safety is still a major worry, and using wearable technology to monitor people in real time might make them feel more secure. The goal of this project is to use wearable device-integrated blood pressure (BP) and heart rate (HR) sensors to construct a women safety analytics system. The biometric data is continuously monitored by the system to identify any abnormal physiological patterns, such as abrupt increases in blood pressure or heart rate, that could signal danger or distress. This data is processed and analyzed by a mobile application, which then sends out alerts to authorities or emergency contacts if any unexpected trends are found. GPS monitoring for position sharing and machine learning algorithms for anomaly detection and predictive analytics are additional features. By offering real-time notifications and previous trend analysis to comprehend stress patterns, this technology guarantees quicker reaction times. The initiative prioritizes data privacy and user security while providing a holistic safety solution for women by integrating biometric analytics with communication protocols.

Author Keywords: safe and secure surroundings for women

articleTitle: Healthy/Unhealthy Tomato Fruit Grading Using Deep-Learning with Features Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Food products automatic grading is a necessary process for appropriate selection, packaging, and marketing. Food grading based on artificial-intelligence (AI) technique for automating the whole process. This work considered the tomato for the study and this procedure is employed to categorize vegetables according to their grade. Proposed work implements a Deep-Learning (DL) based technique to grade the tomato. The stages of this research includes; image collection and resizing, feature extraction with a chosen model, feature reduction with 50% dropout and serial features integration to generate Fused-features Vector (FV), and classification using 3-fold cross validation and confirmation. The efficacy of this tool is evaluated using different DL-model using the chosen image data and this work achieved a detection accuracy >98% when FV based classification is executed using SoftMax. This result confirms that the proposed scheme helps to achieve a better result on the chosen tomato image data.

articleTitle: An Efficient Compression Technique using Modified Wavelet Transform for Brain Tumor Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: With the modern advancement in communication and E-Medical technologies which leads to an important responsibility in telemedicine as this helps health center in acquiring patient information even when they are away from patients. Also the need processing medical image in digital for diagnosis has been significantly increased as a result of digital radiology. Thus this imposes great challenges in storing and transmitting medical images without any degradation. The proposed methodology is a lossless compression scheme specific for Medical Resonance Imaging (MRI) brain images containing tumor. It involves the partition of the input image into region of importance (ROI) and region of non importance (RONI) using K-means algorithm. Differential Pulse Code Modulation (DPCM) with Curvelet transform is applied for the ROI part. Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) followed by Set Partitioning in Hierarchical Tree (SPIHT) and adaptive arithmetic coding is applied for RONI part. The combined compressed outputs result in the final compressed image, and the performance metrics, including peak signal-to-noise ratio, compression ratio, and entropy, demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms existing techniques.

articleTitle: Overview of AMBA AHB2APB Bridge for SOC Interconnects
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The swift evolution of technology demands a highly efficient system with seamless integration of components. Evolution of System on Chip (SOC) has modified making use of different components within a single chip. Therefore, it becomes very crucial to manage these components. The Advanced Microcontroller Bus Architecture (AMBA) bus architecture, a standard SOC interconnection, enhance Intellectual Property (IP) core reusability and streamlines data transmission. Advanced High-Performance Bus (AHB) is part of AMBA family used for High-speed data transfer communication protocol manages with high bandwidth components like processor or memory. Advanced Peripheral Bus (APB) is specifically used for connecting with low bandwidth components like keyboard and mouse. Thus, the importance of AHB2APB bridge becomes very vital. It is the backbone of all data transfer that takes place within a SOC. This paper focuses on reviewing different reported studies in this field, implementing Register Transfer Level (RTL) schematic of AHB2APB bridge.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Manual and GIS-Based Watershed Delineation Techniques Using DEMs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Effective watershed management is essential for sustainable water resource planning and ecological conservation. This study examines the Cooum Watershed in Tamil Nadu, India, comparing manual delineation methods with GIS-based approaches using Digital Elevation Models (DEMs) from ASTER and GM-TED. It analyzes river network changes between 1999 and 2010, validating GIS data with GPS inputs to assess the accuracy of automated delineation techniques. The findings highlight GIS's effectiveness in stream network extraction while addressing limitations like georeferencing errors.

articleTitle: Enhancing KYC Systems through Stroj Decentralized Storage Network in Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The Know Your Customer (KYC) procedure is essential to contemporary regulatory and financial frameworks. Its goals are to stop illegal activity and confirm the identification of clients. Traditional KYC procedures, however, have issues with accessibility, privacy, and data security. In order to overcome these obstacles, this article presents an innovative integration of the Stroj decentralized storage network into blockchain-based KYC systems. Numerous built-in characteristics of blockchain technology can improve KYC procedures. Transparency and immutability are two of these qualities. Blockchain guarantees that KYC-related data cannot be changed or tampered with by using a distributed ledger. Furthermore, the KYC process may be audited and held more accountable because to blockchain's transparency. The problems that conventional KYC systems have can be uniquely solved by the decentralized storage network Stroj. Stroj's distributed data storage features minimize the possibility of data loss or manipulation by ensuring that KYC information is safely saved among several nodes. The suggested KYC solution makes it possible to securely and effectively share KYCrelated data by fusing blockchain technology with the Stroj decentralized storage network. Cryptographic methods and smart contracts are employed to guarantee that the data is only accessible to those who are permitted. This preserves sensitive information's security and privacy while enabling smooth cooperation between financial institutions, authorities, and clients.

articleTitle: ReDiaSafe: A Novel Approach for Predicting 30-Day Diabetes Patient Readmission Risk
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Diabetes is an ailment where life becomes dangerous because most readmissions occur within 30 days since patients do not have any means of awareness towards controlling this health issue. Hospital readmission prevention, especially regarding inpatient or outpatient care, has always been very important in improving patient care, satisfaction, and cost benefits in health care. This paper is on ReDiaSafe as a machine learning tool for predicting the probability of 30-day hospital readmissions in a diabetic patient. It intended to identify useful data attributes and build predictive models that are able to classify readmission risks with accuracy. Thorough research on user input data had been conducted and feature analysis done to elicit significant parameters that influence readmission likelihood. Several machine learning technologies, notably LightGBM and logistic regression; have been applied to classify patients into risk categories: low, medium, and high risk. Our results showed several features with strong relationships to readmission risk, including demographic variables, past admissions, lab results, and medication use patterns. Out of all models tested, the one found most promising with regard to predictions was LightGBM, as this learned well to differentiate risk categories. Furthermore, the combining with an interactive AI chatbot provides individual healthcare suggestions and recommendations based on personalized risk assessments to better engage and support the users. This is further enhanced by the ReDiaSafe tool, which goes a long way in harnessing state-of-the-art machine learning techniques for appalling and really meaningful hospital readmission risk estimates for diabetic patients. This way, better quality of life for the patients is achieved with this method towards life preservation. However, this will also potentially offer general healthcare practitioners segmented interventions towards a much more reduced readmission rate.

articleTitle: Self Regulating Classification of Healthy and AMD Class Retinal OCT Images with Deep-Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) images offer cross-sectional imaging of retina excluding the need of conventional method. It enables the diagnosis of various retinal diseases by non-invasive technique. Age-related Macular Degeneration (AMD) is among the major eye diseases that affect human vision. Early detection of AMD may help to prevent the vision loss. This work deals deep learning approach diagnosis of diseases based on classification of OCT images into healthy and AMD groups. The proposed model has three stages of operation: binary classification, feature extraction and image resizing. Various deep learning algorithms are tested for the selected images and EfficientNetV2S approach produces better response based on the parametric metrics with an accuracy of 0.95.

articleTitle: Significant Improvement in Channel Control by Adjusting Insulator Thickness in CNTFETs to Enhance Drain Current Compared with Traditional High “k” Di-Electrics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Aim: The switching efficiency of a Carbon enabled devices such as (CNTFET) is a crucial component that may be used to enhance channel control, which can significantly raise the drain current and make the CNTFET a dependable part for high-performance electronic applications. A critical step in maximizing the switching efficiency is Insulator thickness modulation. The study dealt with the investigation in the effects of Insulator thickness on CNTFETs figure of merit that determines the behavior of a transistor in the sub threshold region and optimizing leakage current. Simulation models were developed to investigate the relationship between Insulator thickness and switching efficiency in light of the CNTFET's electrical and physical characteristics. The results show that the Insulator thickness is inversely proportional to the switching efficiency and directly proportional to the drain current. This link can be explained by the fact that a wider electron transport system with fewer sub-threshold leakages results from greater gate channel control and decreased junction trap density. The findings of this study demonstrate that CNTFETs are a desirable option for applications in next-generation electronics since their performance may be greatly increased by adjusting the Insulator thickness with different gate insulators. The aforementioned findings provide crucial information for the design and advancement of upcoming carbon-enabled systems and promote the development of CNTFETs as a competitive substitute for MOSFETs.

articleTitle: Normal/Cataract Detection in Fundus Image Using Individual and Fused ResNet Features
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The visual sensory information collected by the eyes is crucial for accurate perception and decision-making in the brain. Any ocular ailment will disrupt this process, perhaps resulting in mild to severe vision-related complications. Ocular ailments are primarily attributable to disease or senescence. Age-related eye illness is a prevalent concern that necessitates prompt detection and intervention. Cataract is a prevalent age-related ocular condition that results in mild to severe visual impairment and necessitates a small surgical intervention for correction. The image-guided identification of cataracts is a clinical practice, and this research intends to present a Deep Learning (DL) method to categorize Retinal Fundus Images (RFI) as normal or cataract. The proposed scheme comprises several phases: (i) image acquisition and resizing to 224×224 pixels, (ii) feature extraction utilizing a DL- model, (iii) optimal model selection, feature reduction with 50% dropout, and concatenation of serial features, and (iv) classification accompanied by 3-fold cross-validation to validate performance. This study evaluates the efficacy of the suggested DL-tool utilizing both traditional and fused-features. The experimental results of this work demonstrate that the fused-features technique achieves > 98% accuracy when applied to SM-based categorization.

articleTitle: Heart Sound Classification Using Signal Processing and Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases” Heart attacks and strokes are often sudden, severe incidents. due to impediments that impede blood flow to the Often, heart attacks and strokes are sudden, severe events. resulting from impediments that impede blood flow to the heart or brain. Themajor cause of these obstructions is the deposition of fatty deposits on the inner walls of blood arteries. Unlike traditionalmethods that rely on analysing heart sounds with a stethoscope, this hybrid approach aims to enhance prediction accuracy by capturing intricate patterns in heart function. RNN and LSTMexcel at processing sequential data, making them suitable for analysing The temporal aspect of heart sound patterns. By leveraging their ability to retain and process information over time, the system aims to provide a more nuanced understanding of heart function, thus improving prediction accuracy beyond the current 87.5% achieved via conventional machine learning techniques like decision trees and Random Forest. Through comparative analysis, this study seeks to demonstrate the potential for significantly enhanced prediction accuracy, offering a more robust diagnostic tool for early detection of cardiovascular diseases, thereby Improving patient outcomes and alleviating the burden of heart-related health issues.

articleTitle: Automated Crime Reporting and Incident Managemnet System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: As a result of the increasing reliance on digital platforms, there has been a proliferation of online crime reporting systems. These systems offer citizens a straightforward and efficient method of reporting occurrences. This article provides a detailed description of the design and development of a “Automated Crime Reporting and Incident Management System,” with a particular focus on the incorporation of user-friendly interfaces, data security protocols, and real-time reaction capabilities. In order to improve the efficiency of crime reporting and data management, the system makes it possible for law enforcement agencies and the general public to communicate in a way that is both clear and quick. Among the features that are included in the proposed system are interoperability with several platforms, automated case assignment, and status tracking responsibilities. Within the realm of public safety, this article investigates the system's potential to improve transparency, reduce the number of manual operations, and increase the amount of service that is provided.

articleTitle: Advanced Smart Transportation System Using V2V Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This paper presents an advanced smart transportation system utilizing vehicle-to- vehicle (V2V) communication technology to improve real-time data exchange between vehicles, enhancing decision- making and safety for drivers. The implementation of V2V communication in smart transportation aims to create a safer, more efficient, and sustainable driving experience, paving the way for the future of autonomous vehicles and intelligent traffic management systems. This article introduces a responsive traffic signal control system that modifies signal durations depending on current traffic density data through V2V communication. The system, built using Veins, SUMO, OMNeT++, and OpenStreetMaps, successfully reduced congestion and improved traffic flow efficiency in simulated urban environments.

articleTitle: Usage of Basic Geometrical Ideas and Principles of Symmetry for Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The paper discusses the usage of geometric principles and theories in order to manipulate the position of decision boundary itself to classify data points belonging to two different classes. Moving away from the close relation between statistical approaches at classification, we will attempt to create a classifier that establishes a more direct connection, and works with the decision boundary. We explore binary classification problems using the dataset, compare convergence conditions and evaluate our results against some popular classifiers.

articleTitle: Intelligent Water Management System Utilizing AI for Precision Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Water scarcity is a growing concern, particularly in agriculture, where efficient water management is essential for sustainability and crop yield. This work presents an AI-based irrigation management system aimed at optimizing water utilization through the analysis of real-time soil moisture data, meteorological forecasts, and crop-specific water needs. The system employs IoT-enabled soil sensors and predictive machine learning algorithms to dynamically modify irrigation schedules, thereby substantially minimizing water waste and optimizing crop output. The suggested approach amalgamates several data sources and machine learning methodologies to provide a fully automated and adaptive irrigation system tailored to the distinct requirements of each crop type and growth phase. Experimental findings demonstrate significant enhancements in water efficiency and productivity, underscoring the promise of AI and IoT in enhancing precision agriculture. This study offers a scalable and sustainable methodology for agricultural water management, aiding global initiatives in water conservation and food security enhancement.

articleTitle: Early Melanoma Detection and Classification Using CNN and Confusion Matrix Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This article brings up a new method for detecting and classifying skin cancers using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Confusion Matrix analysis. The main work of this work evolves around detection of Melanoma and Non Melanoma cells. The large dataset on skin cancers is used to teach the CNN model to accurately classify different types of skin lesions into different malignant and non-cancerous groups. The integration of Confusion Matrix, in this case, allows for accurate identification of the classification errors made by the model as well as possible areas for improvement hence making it possible to comprehensively evaluate how well the model performs. Therefore, early recognition is indispensable to successful treatment as skin cancer is a typical yet fatal condition. Results shows that the suggested proposed model achieves 95.5% accuracy and performance in comparison with other methods found in literature. Additionally, Modified DenseNet201 model has a sensitivity of 95.96% as well as a specificity of 98.03%.

articleTitle: Deficiencies Identification and Detection in Grape Plant Leaves Using LSTM and CNN Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: To address mineral shortages in soils, modern fertilization methods identify nutritional deficits in plant foliage. To formulate a fertilization plan that delivers essential micronutrients without excessive production of others, it is crucial to ascertain the requisite quantities of vitamins and minerals. Nutritional inadequacies in agriculture are signaled by the leaves of plants. Physical examination of these leaves from the plant's morphological components provides sufficient information to determine nutritional deficiencies. The main aim of this study was to ascertain nutritional deficits in grapevine leaves. This research use Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for model training. By inputting the model's output into an LSTM, we can categorize grape plant leaf images as healthy or exhibiting deficiencies in nitrogen, iron, phosphorus, manganese, potassium, zinc, calcium, boron, magnesium, or sulfur. Accuracy evaluates the model's efficacy. The data analysis indicated that the proposed model achieved an accuracy rate of 98.6 percent. The results indicate that convolution neural networks (CNNs) may be effective in detecting nutritional deficiencies in grape plant leaves.

articleTitle: A Delay Phase Precoder Design For Terahertz Massive MIMO Beyond 5G Communication System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The future of wireless communication systems beyond 5G (B5G) is expected to leverage the terahertz (THz) band to achieve unprecedented data rates. Delay phase precoding in massive MIMO beyond 5G is like making sure each antenna talks at the right time and in the right way to improve communication. The proposed technique leverages the distinctive characteristics of the THz band, such as highly directional transmissions and sparse channel responses, to mitigate channel impairments and enhance signal quality. The design aims to exploit the spatial domain by incorporating delay and phase adjustments, ensuring efficient signal transmission and reception. By leveraging the unique properties of THz frequencies and massive MIMO configurations, the proposed precoder design enhances spectral efficiency and system reliability, thus facilitating the realization of high-data-rate communication systems beyond the capabilities of current 5G networks. This technique helps reduce interference and makes wireless signals stronger and more reliable, which is super important for faster and better connections in the next generation of wireless technology. The impact of hardware constraints, such as phase shifters and analog-to-digital converters (ADCs), on the practical implementation of the proposed precoding algorithm are explored. The proposed delay phase precoder is designed to selects the optimal delay and phase precoding Matrix at the transmitter end. Our simulation results also validates the improvement in performance in terms of spectral efficiency and energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Design of ResNet50-LSTM Model with Attention Mechanism and Transfer Learning for Microexpression Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Our face can show different emotions. From the feelings, one can identify the emotional state of a person. Micro expression is a subtle facial movement that reveals a person's subconscious feelings. Detecting micro-expressions is essential to detect the human emotional state, which is very helpful for the therapist or psychologist. This paper presents a method of micro expression recognition using the model that combines ResNet50-LSTM with an attention mechanism and Transfer Learning. ResNet50 captures the spatial features, LSTM for temporal dependencies between frames. The attention mechanism finetuned the built model. We adopted transfer learning to enhance the model's performance in detecting subtle micro-expressions. Experiments were conducted on benchmark micro-expression datasets such as SAMM and CASME II. The results show the model's superior performance in recognising emotions, which can help understand human psychology.

articleTitle: Image Classification of Corn Seeds Using Ensemble-Based CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: As corn has become staple food for people in many countries around the world, that directly increases its production. The versatile nature of maize plant is the reason for its highest cultivation among all other staple foods. As many food industries demand for good quality of corn seeds for usage in their own products. The quality of corn seeds depends on the various factors like type, color, condition, texture, size, etc. The image classification technique using Convolutional Neural Networks shown high accuracy in the selection of good quality of corn seeds. But on the other hand, for image classification of tons of corn seeds, CNN has to extract large number of features. Therefore, this paper proposes the image classification of corn seed using the CNN and ensemble learning technique. The proposed work shown good performance compared to the conventional CNN methods.

articleTitle: Road Traffic Incident Detection and Management Using Image Analysis for Chennai City
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The paper analyses systematically widespread problems exiting in the most of the areas, which include incomplete in traffic incident in city, and lack of traffic information about the city. In view of these problems, the paper proposes to enhance the effectiveness of the traveller information. Traffic incidents are unavoidable in present traffic conditions. Hence it is necessary to manage the traffic incidents to reduce the loss time and cost due to the incidents. GIS is a suitable tool to manage the traffic incidents. This paper presents a GIS - based Traveller Information System developed for the Chennai city road network. The effect of the traffic incident on capacity, and alternative path are presented in the GIS framework.

articleTitle: Adaptive Dynamic Speed Limiter for Enhanced Safety and Efficiency in Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Electric Vehicles (EVs) have revolutionized transportation, providing eco-friendly alternatives to traditional internal combustion engine vehicles. As the number of Electric Vehicles on the road increases, there is a critical need for systems that ensure both safety and operational efficiency. The proposed Adaptive Dynamic Speed Limiter system adjusts a vehicle's speed dynamically based on external control signals transmitted wirelessly. The system uses a transmitter to send predefined commands corresponding to different speed levels or stop conditions. A receiver integrated into the EV decodes these signals and modifies the vehicle's motor speed accordingly. An LCD provides real-time feedback to the driver and displays the vehicle's current status. The adaptive dynamic model ensures compliance with traffic regulations, reduces energy consumption, and enhances safety for both drivers and pedestrians. By integrating advanced control mechanisms, the project contributes to developing smarter, safer EVs.

articleTitle: CNN-Driven Terrain Analysis and Infrared Soil Hydration Control in Autonomous UAV-Based Urban Reforestation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative AI-driven plantation drone designed to automate the process of land selection, irrigation, and seed planting. The system utilizes a web camera for real-time image processing to identify empty and fertile land for planting. An infrared humidity sensor monitors soil moisture, and the drone sprays water in areas with insufficient humidity. Once the ideal moisture level is reached, a seed ball, containing both seeds and fertilizer, is shot into the soil using a built-in dispenser. This fully autonomous process aims to reduce human intervention in plantation activities while optimizing land usage and improving crop success rates. The AI algorithms ensure precise detection and planting, while the drone's navigation system enhances efficiency. Preliminary testing demonstrates significant improvements in water conservation, planting accuracy, and time efficiency compared to manual methods, showcasing the system's potential for sustainable agricultural practices.

articleTitle: Rheumatic Carditis Screening Unveiled on YOLO Algorithms Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Rheumatic Heart Disease (RHD is a chronic condition resulting from rheumatic fever, which is caused by a group A Streptococcal infection. It primarily affects children and young adults, especially in low- and middle-income countries, and is a leading cause of morbidity and mortality in these populations. The disease manifests through inflammation and scarring of the heart valves, often leading to long-term complications like heart failure, arrhythmias, and valve dysfunction. Early detection and accurate staging of RHD are crucial for effective treatment and prevention of further complications. This publication explores the potential of integrating the YOLO (You Only Look Once) algorithm with advanced imaging techniques, such as Echocardiogram and Cardiac MRI to automate RHD detection and staging. Echocardiogram offers detailed real-time volumetric imaging of the heart, allowing for improved diagnosis of valve abnormalities, while Cardiac MRI is invaluable in assessing myocardinal fibrosis and heart function in advanced RHD case. YOLO, a real-time object detection algorithm, can be applied to these imaging modalities to identify heart valve lesions, regurgitation, and fibrosis with high accuracy. This automated approach aims to provide real-time diagnostic insights, classify patients into different stages of RHD, and support clinicians in decision-making. However, challenges such as data availability, sensitivity to subtle image features, and regulatory hurdles remain. The integration of machine learning with medical imaging could revolutionize RHD diagnosis, particularly in resource-limited settings, by improving accuracy, reducing diagnostic time, and enabling large-scale screening programs. Further research and development are needed to refine these technologies for clinical use.

articleTitle: Enhancing Satellite Imagery: Time-Varying Neural Network Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Landsat images are essential in geoinformatics and earth observation. However, clouds frequently contaminate satellite images, making cloud removal increasingly necessary due to the growing demand for satellite imagery applications. In order to improve the quality of Landsat imagery, we suggest a novel Time-Varying Features Neural Network (TVFN-N) that consists of several modules: cloud detection, a learning module, feature fusion, and image reconstruction. Metrics including the Structural Similarity Index (SSIM), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), and Peak Signal Noise Ratio (PSNR) are used to assess how effective the reconstructed images are as individuals. Our tests show that the suggested strategy is quantitatively successful, obtaining an RMSE of less than 0.0179. TVFN-N shows significant improvement in reconstructing Landsat images using multitemporal methods compared to older deep learning techniques. Additionally, we compared our approach using cutting-edge deep learning models and produced more accurate outcomes for jobs involving cloud removal.

articleTitle: Efficiently Identifying Fake Audio and Images Using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
