abstract: Over the years, the field of multimedia forensics has made great strides in the detection of manipulation of digital content, mainly facilitated by advancements in deep learning. Nevertheless, state-of-the-art systems with DNN come with severe limitations, including very low prediction accuracy for fake audio as well as being unable to analyze manipulated images. We therefore suggest adoption of a hybrid approach using the RNN. Designed to detect accurately whether an audio or image has been manipulated, using that captured temporal dynamics of audio and image processing techniques. Our system trains the audio and image data separately to make a more specific and precise detection. We also developed a friendly web application using Bootstrap, so it can be easily analyzed by users for multimedia content. With integration of RNN in our system, the RNN achieved a high degree of accuracy in both fake audio detection and manipulated images, elevating the general performance in the multimedia forensics domain. This enhances not just the detection ability but also leaves an open door to further research on this subject within a strong framework, for identification of multimedia manipulation within a growing complex digital landscape.

articleTitle: Real-Time Lung Cancer Detection Using GAN-Enhanced LDCT Imaging and CNN-Based Classification for Clinical Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Lung cancer stands as the leading contributor to cancer- related casualties on a global scale, holds the topmostmortality rates for both males and females. Tobacco using up is responsible for approximately equivalent to 85% of all instances of lung cancer, which makes it the primary cause of the illness. Frequently, cancer of the lungs is suspected in its advanced stages, limiting treatment options. Lung cancer is still one of the leading causes of cancer- related deaths globally, and better patient outcomes depend on early identification. Low- Dose Computed Tomography (LDCT) scans are widely utilized to test for lung cancer, but the inherent noiseand Variations in raw LDCT images pose substantial challenges for accurate diagnosis. This paper proposes a real-time lung cancer detection system that leverages the power of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN). The system is designed to classify lung cancer in LDCT images while addressing the issue of image quality degradation inraw scans. The GAN model is employed to generate high quality synthetic images from raw LDCT inputs, enhancing their clarity and usability for diagnostic purposes. These improved images are then fed into a CNN model, which performs the lung cancer detection. The proposed system was assessed and evaluated on a dataset of LDCT images, demonstrating superior effectiveness in classification sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy relative to traditional methods. Our results highlight the potentialof combining GAN - generated synthetic images with CNN-based classification for more accurate and reliable real-time lung cancer detection, providing a robust solution for early-stage cancer diagnosis in clinical settings.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Scheduling Approaches for Efficient Data Transmission in Wireless HART Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The rapid evolution of industrial automation systems has driven the need for highly reliable and efficient communication networks. Wireless HART, a prominent wireless protocol tailored for industrial applications, is widely adopted due to its robust performance in harsh environments. However, optimizing network performance, particularly in terms of latency and packet loss, remains a critical challenge. This paper presents a comparative analysis of various scheduling techniques like Time-Slotted Channel Hopping (TSCH), Low-Power Wireless Bus (LWB), Machine Learning (ML) based approaches, Round-Robin Scheduling (RRS), and Frequency Division Multiple Access (FDMA) within the Wireless HART network architecture. By simulating these techniques in a typical industrial wireless network scenario, the study evaluates their impact on latency and packet loss metrics. The results indicate that ML-based approaches offer significant improvements in latency reduction and reliability, outperforming traditional techniques such as TSCH and LWB. The findings provide valuable insights for industrial practitioners aiming to enhance the performance of Wireless HART networks through the adoption of advanced scheduling strategies.

articleTitle: Generalized Discriminate Analysis for Classification Algorithms in a Tuned Machine Learning Model for Steganalysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Recent years have witnessed fast technological advancement, leading to the extensive utilization of multimedia for data transmission, especially inside the Internet of Things (IOT) network channels were generally utilized for transmission. The utilization of the internet for the sharing of digital media has proliferated, with governments, private enterprises, institutions, and individuals now engaging in this kind of multimedia data transport. Despite several advantages, the privacy and security of the data present significant drawbacks. The probability of hostile attacks, eavesdropping, and other subversive activities has escalated due to the accessibility of several publicly available technologies that can compromise privacy, data integrity, and the security of transmitted information. This research thoroughly examines several classification algorithms with the main aim of conducting a comparative assessment of classification algorithms for a refined machine learning model for steganalysis utilizing an effective feature extraction technique. The examined algorithms encompass a broad range, including AdaBoost, Ensemble Classifiers, Naive Bayes, Generalized Discriminant Analysis (GDA), Single Model Averages (SMA), and Transfer Learning (TL) The inquiry meticulously assesses their precision within the context of steganalysis. This research seeks to identify the unique advantages and disadvantages of each algorithm by comparing their performance, providing valuable insights for practitioners and researchers in the field. These findings have implications in the biological sciences, particularly in safeguarding sensitive biological data from cyber threats. Ensuring the security of biological data is crucial for the advancement of biological sciences, the integrity of scientific research, and the safeguarding of privacy.

articleTitle: IoT Based Cloud-Integrated Smart Parking System With Reservation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Smart Parking System as a better alternative that accepts QR codes for the ESP32CAM is a tiny module based on ESP32 chip and OV2640. User Acceptance Testing has been performed with the help of the QR codes. The proposed system is based on ESP32 module which is a 10 GPIO module with a 2 mega pixel camera with it the camera is used to scan the QR code and give access to the user to open gate. Whenever an authorized QR code which mentioned in program is scanned the door opens and the green LED is switched on and alert is sent to the mobile in the form of a message. But if an unauthorized code is scanned red LED is displayed and also alert is given in the form of alarm sound and will send a message to the user. The existing system has a slide door which is opened using the L293D motor driver IC. So, using the authorized code the slide door is opened. Even to close the door the QR code must be scanned. The security concern is achieved through the alert given to the user every time when it is operated. The proposed system have a feature of identifying availability of slots. IR sensors connected to the ARDUINO for object detection at the respective slots are indicated with the help of LED, so the admin can monitor the available spaces in the parking area by checking the data from the database. To make this process possible in practical world a website is created using HTML, CSS, JAVA Script and SQL database. This website acts like a booking portal where the client can book the slot, get to know the slot details, select the parking time period and all other added features.

articleTitle: Enhancing Data Security and Efficiency: A Hybrid Cloud Approach to Secure Authorized Deduplication
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: As cloud services grow, data deduplication has become crucial for reducing storage costs and improving resource utilization by eliminating duplicate data. However, maintaining data security and user privacy in deduplication-enabled environments remains a significant challenge due to increasing risks of unauthorized access and data breaches. To address this, convergent encryption has been proposed, allowing data encryption before outsourcing while supporting deduplication. This paper introduces a hybrid cloud approach for secure authorized deduplication, combining public and private clouds to optimize efficiency, data integrity, and confidentiality. Our solution uses a dual-layer authentication and encryption mechanism, where key generation is tied to user privileges and file ownership. The control plane is managed by the private cloud, handling sensitive metadata and keys, while the public cloud stores deduplicated data to ensure cost efficiency. We further introduce differential user privileges in duplicate checks, a feature lacking in traditional systems. To validate our approach, we developed a prototype and conducted testbed experiments. The results show substantial reductions in storage overhead and latency, with minimal performance impact. Security analysis confirms that our scheme meets the required security guarantees, providing a scalable and efficient solution for cloud deduplication while addressing privacy and performance concerns.

articleTitle: Object Detection Using Deep Learning for Blind People with Voice Feedback
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: BlindSpace is an innovative application aimed at improving the lives of visually challenged individuals. Leveraging cutting-edge image captioning and object detection technologies, the app allows users to capture images using their smartphone's camera, providing detailed scene descriptions and audibly identifying objects within those images. This not only enhances users' understanding of their environment but also fosters independence and confidence. With voice commands and text-to-speech technology, the application offers a user-friendly experience and can be customized to individual preferences. Operating efficiently offline, BlindSpace stands as a significant leap in accessibility technology, bridging the gap between the visual and non-visual worlds for visually challenged individuals and promoting inclusivity and autonomy

articleTitle: Lightweight Deep-Learning Based Metal/Plastic Trash Detection with Fused Features
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Recently, several approaches have been proposed for the proper management of waste to achieve environmental sustainability and resource conservation. Proper garbage disposal reduces pollution and prevents the contamination of water and soil. This study proposes a deep-learning tool (DLT) for the automatic detection of metal/plastic waste to enhance the recycling process. This work created the DLT by utilizing a Lightweight Deep Learning (LWDL) model to establish a more efficient and less intricate method. The stages in this tool encompass: the collection of trash images and their resizing to 224x224x3 pixels, feature extraction utilizing the selected LWDL model, performance evaluation through binary classification with three-fold cross-validation, and the identification of the top two LWDL models to produce fused deep features (FDF) to enhance classification accuracy. The experimental method employs the SoftMax utilizing individual LWDL features and FDF, and the findings affirm that the proposed tool yields superior metal/plastic waste classification results compared to the individual features. In the future, this technique may be utilized to categorize authentic waste photographs captured with a digital camera.

articleTitle: Enhancing High-Frequency Inverter Performance in WPT EV Charging Systems by Reducing Current Ripple Through Step Density Modulation Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This paper analyses Step Density Modulation (SDM) techniques for high-frequency inverters in Wireless Power Transfer (WPT) systems for Electric Vehicle (EV) charging. Pulse Density Modulation (PDM) is widely used to control high-frequency inverters, but it struggles to manage current ripple, which can cause EMI, power transfer efficiency loss, and system degradation. In this paper, Step Density Modulation is offered as an upgrade over standard PDM to reduce effects of dead time in inverters by providing more precise pulse density and timing control. PDM modifies pulse density evenly, whereas Step Density Modulation dynamically varies pulse density in discrete stages to match the inverter's switching characteristics. Current ripple and harmonics are reduced, enhancing waveform quality and power transfer efficiency. A thorough mathematical model compares current ripple magnitude, frequency spectrum, and inverter delay time for the two modulation techniques. Detailed MATLAB models simulated on a 5 kW WPT EV charger show that Step Density Modulation outperforms PDM in reducing current ripple and improving inverter performance. Step Density Modulation reduces current ripple by 30% more than PDM, smoothing inverter output and improving system stability. This innovative modulation scheme improves WPT system efficiency and reliability for EV charging applications.

articleTitle: Leveraging AI-Driven Machine Learning Approaches -SVM and RESNET-50 For Predicting Esophageal Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Esophageal cancer, a very aggressive malignancy, exhibits a significant mortality rate attributed to late diagnosis and diverse patient responses to therapeutic interventions including chemotherapy, radiation therapy, and immunotherapy. Customized therapy suggestions are essential for enhancing patient outcomes; however, existing methodologies depend on generic models that fail to consider individual heterogeneity. This paper proposes an AI-driven approach utilizing machine learning algorithms, that includes Support Vector Machines (SVM) ResNet-50 structure for deep convolutional neural networks and its objective is to classify the Barrett's esophagus and adenocarcinoma cancers. As multilayered perceptron's are the center of the approach, determined which maximal classification in ResNet-50 would be appropriate layers and trained them to cut to avoid redundancy. It was demonstrated that regional information and high-dimensional features are important to enhance classification. Also, maximal layer discrimination and differential effect can be important in Barrett's esophagus and adenocarcinoma classification training on ResNet50. The model improves precision through the incorporation of clinical data to plan individualized treatment pathways. It has shown more sensitivity in terms of the detection of neoplasia in Barrett's esophagus, reaching up to 90% as compared to conventional techniques. The experimental findings indicate enhanced prediction accuracy, precision, sensitivity relative to conventional approaches. This AI system offers a prospective option for the optimization of individualized treatment in esophageal cancer therapy.

articleTitle: FPGA Accelerated High Speed Radix-4 Parallel Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Multiplication is essential in the field of digital systems like DSP, AI and ML. The VLSI field involves the reduction of minimising area, power consumption, delay and improving efficiency. This paper introduces a FPGA accelerated high-speed radix 4 parallel multiplier which reduces delay. The CSA is modified to have a 4-bit adder, two half adders and a 2-bit RCA. It makes the multiplier more efficient by reducing the cell delay. The parallel addition process used here improves performance. The number of logic elements used does not differ from the existing model thus bringing no change in the structure. The proposed multiplier is implemented using VHDL on Altera Quartus II. This makes it useful for applications such as High Performance computing system (HPC), FPGA based systems, Custom ASIC designs, Quantum computing and 5G or future communication systems.

articleTitle: Convolution Neural Network for Indentifying Autism Spectrum Disorder in Children
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopment condition characterized by irregularities in brain development that affect face morphology. Children with autism have significant differences in the configuration of their facial characteristics compared to ordinarily developing children. This study proposes a novel deep-learning approach for detecting autism through facial cues, employing a convolutional neural network with a multi-head attention mechanism (CNNMHA), thereby facilitating the diagnostic process for families and physicians. It primarily employs two phases: preprocessing and classification. During this preparation phase, the suggested system executes image resizing, Gaussian filtering for denoising, and normalization to improve image quality and suitability for the given classification task. During the classification phases, the proposed system employs CNNMHA to extract features from the preprocessed picture and categorizes the images as depicting autistic or non-autistic children. The data were acquired from Kaggle, and the initial computational findings indicate that the suggested approach surpassed current methodologies. The technology can assist medical practitioners in corroborating their first screening results to identify children with ASD.

articleTitle: Alternate Approach for Space Debris Removal to Promote Space Sustainability Along with Delta-V Requirements
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Space Debris is a major concern over space that occurs in the present day. The paper proposes a comprehensive Space Debris Removal System designed to tackle the increasing threat of space debris, specifically in Low Earth Orbit (LEO). The proposed debris removal system is divided into two stages: in the first stage, four modules are stationed in LEO for debris collection along with one module that transports debris to GEO, and in the second stage, three modules in GEO for the restoration and recycling of collected materials and transporting them to desired orbits, promoting sustainability in space activities by re-purposing debris of defunct satellites. The system's orbital strategy lies in using a Hohmann transfer orbit, selected for its efficiency in orbital maneuvers, supported by detailed delta-V calculations essential for precise maneuver planning. Validation through simulation and testing using the General Mission Analysis Tool(GMAT) confirms the feasibility of these maneuvers. The system aims to mitigate risks posed to operational satellites, space tourism, and communication networks by debris.

articleTitle: Future Electricity Consumption Prediction of Household Using Prophet-GRU Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The Electricity Consumption Monitor and Predictor with Current Sensor Integration is an approach to solving the widespread problem of consumers not being aware of the precise amount of electricity used by individual electrical gadgets. Through the use of hardware- integrated Hall effect current sensor technology, ECMP provides users with real- time information regarding the amount of electricity used by each device. It also notifies users when pre- established consumption criteria are surpassed. By giving customers control over their energy usage habits, this ground- breaking solution encourages sustainable behaviours. ECMP, which can be accessed through a secure website with unique login credentials, provides comprehensive insights on the power consumption profiles of specific devices, empowering users to make educated decisions regarding their usage patterns. Apart from offering instantaneous insights, ECMP utilizes sophisticated forecasting algorithms to anticipate future electricity consumption rates by analysing extensive meter data. Users are empowered to anticipate and proactively manage future swings in energy usage thanks to these forward- looking capabilities. In addition, ECMP makes use of its data analytics platform to produce tailored suggestions meant to reduce unnecessary energy use. These recommendations, which are based on an abundance of previously acquired meter data, provide individuals looking to optimize their energy usage with useful and actionable insights.

articleTitle: Adaptive Resource Prediction in Containerized Cloud Environments with CNN-LSTM Optimized by SCA
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Many different businesses and professions employ cloud-based microservices because of their exceptional performance capabilities. Containers have evolved into the most trustworthy and lightest virtualization technology for delivering cloud services owing to its flexible sorting, mobility, and scalability. But a quick change causes issues with container management and automation. Numerous research projects have thus far concentrated on resolving the remaining problems with container automation and management. Since resource allocation in containers immediately impacts system and resource consumption, it is actually the cloud providers' top security concern. In order to address resource allocation in containers, this research optimizes the make span and energy using a hybrid optimization technique. Based on metaheuristic optimization and deep learning, specifically Convolutional Neural Network with Long Short-Term Memory networks, this paper presents a hybrid technique that is applied to improve the accuracy of load forecasting models on cloud settings. SCA metaheuristics is used to optimize the hyperparameters of the improved CNN-LSTM model thus capitalizing upon the predictive capability of CNN-LSTM. The general objective of this approach is to improve the accuracy of load prediction, believed to be necessary for proactive load balancing and migration in cloud infrastructures.

articleTitle: Blockchain and AI Based Medical Record Analysis for Bone Fracture on Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Actually, healthcare information can be really upgraded by the combination of blockchain technology with artificial intelligence. Reducing breach risks due to the decentralized and cryptographic protection of blockchain, it simply means that only authorized people would be able to access sensitive information, making the security of the data greatly improved. This also builds interoperability through standardizing protocols for exchanging data and using smart contracts as administered work, hence reducing chances of error and exertion on health care systems. AI contributes to real -time analytics by enabling predictive modeling and clinical decision support for healthcare experts to make informed, on-time decisions based upon a vast data set. The patient-controlled data features offered by Blockchain will empower the patients, bring in trust and transparency, and further ease healthier decisions due to real-time access to health records. It also helps much towards cost efficiency, considering that administrative costs are reduced with the automated process and further reduction of fraud through transparency offered by Blockchain. For instance, it creates clear audit trails for compliance with regulations like HIPAA, making compliance a much easier affair. Its architecture is cloud-based, allowing the system to scale to the demands that will arise from growing amounts of data. Case study and pilot program success stories have shown just how effective this combination of technology and healthcare services can be. This has become patently apparent in the joint proposals from the tech and healthcare companies. Looking ahead, IoT devices integrated with blockchain and AI might open new scopes for real-time health monitoring, whilst current research is working on the further improvement of algorithms and innovative scenarios. Overall, the integrated architecture would be opening a prospect for the new health care data management with improved results.

articleTitle: Enhanced Early Parkinson's Disease Detection Using Resnet-101 Based on MRI Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Early diagnosis of this specified disease is believed to be determing in arresting the progression and allowing patients a chance at disease modifying treatment. One of the primary opportunities for such diagnosis is provided by the premotor stage when slight symptoms may herald the beginning of the disease. Traditional approaches have used the SVM algorithm in predicting the onset of PD; however, they are quite limited in their capabilities concerning the processing of image data. This is a huge disadvantage because image data, such as MRI scans or other medical images, play a very significant role in coming up with accurate diagnoses. To attempt to overcome this limitation, we use the ResNet-101 deep learning algorithm. ResNet-101 is very powerful because it is a CNN, which is an excellent network for image analysis because its deep architecture has 101 layers. This depth allows it to identify detailed patterns and features from medical images, significantly improving prediction accuracy as compared to SVM. We will make it possible for early diagnosis of PD by image data, which also means diagnosis at a premotor stage with much higher precision using ResNet-101. This solution increases the accuracy in predictions but also creates a strong tool for the early diagnosis by the clinicians so that interventions may be provided at a timely and potentially life-altering point. The proposed results shows better and outperformed well than the existing approaches. This research improves prediction accuracy 96.0%, Sensitivity 97.5%, Specificity 96.8%, Precision 94.5%, F1-Score 92.7%, ROC-AUC 98.0%.

articleTitle: Micro Patch Log-Periodic Antenna with Dielectric Resonator 6 GHz MODEM for Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks (VANET's)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This paper presents the design and analysis of a Micro Patch Log-Periodic Antenna integrated with a dielectric resonator, optimized for vehicular ad hoc networks (VANETs) and operating within the 1–6 GHz frequency range. The antenna also incorporates a GPS element and a dedicated 2.5 GHz antenna for ISM devices and sensor interfaces. A comprehensive evaluation of the antenna's performance is conducted, focusing on critical parameters: electric field (E-field) distribution, gain, and Voltage Standing Wave Ratio (VSWR). The E-field distribution exhibits multiple lobes indicative of efficient radiation across various angles, although certain resonators display inefficiencies, suggesting a need for optimization in size and positioning. The gain analysis reveals a maximum gain of 2.19 dB, providing moderate efficiency typical for wideband applications; however, enhancements could improve directivity and overall performance. The VSWR plot highlights effective impedance matching at specific frequencies (notably 2.5 GHz, 4.5 GHz, and 6 GHz) while indicating significant reflection losses at higher frequencies. To enhance the antenna's functionality, recommendations include optimizing the arrangement of dielectric resonators, adjusting the patch and feedline design for better impedance matching, and exploring alternative substrate materials. This work emphasizes the potential of the proposed antenna configuration in facilitating efficient communication within VANETs while supporting other ISM applications.

Author Keywords: Micro Patch Log-Periodic Dielectric Resonator Antenna (MP-LP-DRA)

articleTitle: Optimizing Flight Routes for Better Fuel Efficiency and Optimal Path using Grover's Algorithm & QAOA Algorithm - Quantum Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Optimization of flight routes is one of the hard problems in the aviation sector. This paper focuses on the prospects of quantum computing developed using Grover's Algorithm and the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA). Grover's Algorithm provides a quadratic speedup for searching an unsorted database and is therefore quite useful for identifying optimum flight routes amongst millions of choices. Preliminary benchmarking suggests that it can efficiently search a space of more than one million routes in far less time than the conventional approach, which is important for timely decisions over aviation. Simultaneously, QAOA refines candidate routes with the aid of real-time inputs such as weather and air traffic, and each time delivers near-optimal solutions even during sudden changes. The quantum framework in development would make it possible to improve the accuracy of routes recommended and respond fast to changing circumstances. This includes weather conditions whereby, based on research, estimated savings in fuel by optimizing routes run between 5% to 10%, which translates to costs lower with fewer carbon emissions playing a role in environmental sustainability. Flight scheduling also improves through quantum algorithms because of increased operational efficiency, which would enable airlines to cope better with complicated constraints and not allow delays when flights are involved. In summary, the Grover's Algorithm and QAOA hybrid shows a more holistic approach of giving an advantage regarding speed over the traditional approach as well as flexibility.

articleTitle: Design and Parametric Analysis of Volumetric SIW Antenna Embedded with Parasitic Elements for C,X Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The development of 5G systems, the Internet of Things (IoT) and improvements in aerial radiating in GHz high frequency spectrum bands are mostly attributed to Substrate Integrated Waveguide (SIW) technology. This paper focused on design and parametrics of a volumetric antenna(Microstrip Patch) with parasitic elements and metal vias effects utilizing SIW technology. The suggested antenna uses FR4 (Flame Retardant) as the base material and has the dimensions are 38.5mm x 85mm x 1.6mm. The microstrip patch SIW antenna neighboring sides, two rectangular shaped parasitic patches with metal vias are added. The electromagnetic field distribution is impacted by these parasitic patch elements. Accordingly certain metrics were noted as a result of the electromagnetic field distribution being impacted by these parasitic patch elements. The center frequencies of the two operational bands are 7.20GHz for the first band, which has a reflection coefficient of 21.18dB and 9.36GHz for the second band, which has a reflection coefficient of 27.08dB. The maximum gains are 7.1dB and 6.2dB respectively. SIW technology is employed in the proposed microstrip patch antenna using SIW technology for dual band applications in the C and X bands.

articleTitle: Automated Shuttering Technique Through Innovative Use of Agricultural Land
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In agricultural fields, waterlogging results in crop waste and decreased output. In order to solve this, our system will install an automated shutter system to remove extra rainwater. Farmers receive real-time rainfall and shutter status notifications via a mobile application. By automating water drainage using sensors, the system lowers staff expenses and the requirement for manual intervention. The app helps with farm management as well. Our approach is simple to use, affordable, and prevents soil deterioration while promoting sustainable practices. Successful field testing have demonstrated lower labor costs and higher production.

articleTitle: Enhancing Heavy Vehicle Safety with Intelligent Driver Behaviour Monitoring via Multi-Sensor Fusion and Embedded Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This research presents the development of a sensor fusion-based driver assistance system (DAS) aimed at enhancing the safety of heavy vehicle operators. The system integrates an alcohol sensor, an ADXL 335 accelerometer sensor, and an eye blink detection sensor with an Arduino platform for real-time monitoring of driver behaviour. LabVIEW software was employed for data processing and visualization, providing a user-friendly interface to track driver alertness, speed, and alcohol consumption. A classification algorithm was implemented to categorize the driver's condition into various risk levels based on sensor inputs. Alerts were generated in real-time to notify the driver of potential hazards, such as drowsiness, intoxication, or speeding. Experimental trials demonstrated the system's effectiveness in accurately detecting dangerous driving behaviours and issuing timely warnings. The use of sensor fusion enhanced data reliability by cross-verifying multiple inputs, reducing false positives. The system proved to be robust and practical for implementation in heavy vehicle operations, contributing to road safety. Future enhancements may include additional physiological sensors, integration with vehicle control systems, and the practise of machine learning (ML) algorithms to improve classification accuracy. This research highlights the potential of sensor fusion technology in the development of advanced DAS, particularly in the transportation sector.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Pseudo-Random Number Generator with Dynamic Seed Reset using 8-bit,16-bit and 32-bit Polynomials
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The development and evaluation of a pseudo-random number generator (PRNG) using 8-bit, 16-bit, and 32-bit polynomials to measure intervals before reconstructing random sequences. To deal with this, a dynamic soft reset mechanism is integrated, which automatically updates the results as it detects repeated patterns, so it automatically searches for unexpected sequences with PRNG examples that were implemented and tested on different FPGA platforms, and evaluates key metrics-such as iteration interval, power efficiency, and resource allocation-for each polynomial The generated results show that the proposed method stops sequence iteration well, especially 32-bit polynomials and this work enhances FPGA-based PRNG design while optimizing resource utilization, providing an effective solution for systems requiring high randomness and security.

articleTitle: Examination of H&E-stained Oral Cavity-Derived Cancer Image: A Study using UDL-Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Oral cancer (OC) is a harsh disease that demands timely detection and intervention. Histopathological image-assisted OC detection involves the assessment of tissue specimens under a microscope to detect abnormal cellular structures (ACS) and patterns. Analyzing the ACS and patterns is necessary to confirm the OC. This study presents a deep-learning (DL) segmentation method to isolate the required portion from the histopathology image. This study utilized the Unified Deep-Learning (UDL) model to improve segmentation precision. The examination scheme comprises several stages: (i) collection of images and masks from the data repository, followed by resizing to 224x224 pixels; (ii) segmentation of the required image section using a UDL scheme; (iii) comparison of the segmented region with the mask and computation of image metrics; and (iv) validation of the UDL model's results against other selected DL schemes. This study use 300 images for training and 100 images for validation/testing. The total experimental result (mean ± standard deviation) obtained during the testing task is deemed to validate the efficacy of the UDL model. The findings of this study validate that the suggested model facilitates superior segmentation accuracy (>93%) on the selected database.

articleTitle: Parameter Estimation of PEM Fuel-Cell Using Brownian Butterfly Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The growing demand for electrical-energy (EE) has driven the development of varied power generation methods to meet global energy needs. The traditional Energy Generation Scheme (EGS) has greater impact on various environmental concerns and hence cleaner and sustainable energy sources are invented. Fuel-cell (FC) is one of the modern EGS, which converts the chemical-energy (CE) into EE with better efficiency. Further, the performance of the FC depends mainly on its parameters and hence it is necessary to identify the finest parameters. This research aims to develop a procedure to optimize the parameters of Nedstack-PS6; a commercially available Proton Exchange Membrane (PEM) FC (PEM-FC). The Nedstack-PS6 is a portable EE-source and its efficiency can be improved by assigning the finest possible value to its parameters. This research proposes a Brownian-Butterfly-Algorithm (BBA) based optimization process using a chosen cost-function for the chosen PEM-FC model. The BBA based search is implemented to solve a 7-dimensional optimization task using a bounded-search methodology and the achieved result with the BBA is compared against few chosen results by the optimization-algorithms. The experimental results confirms that the proposed scheme works well on the chosen PEM-FC model and help to identify the optimal values for all the 7-parametters.

articleTitle: Attention Mechanism with Bayesian Decision Theory for Drug Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Biomedical literature lacks integration of dynamic drug interaction data for personalized prescriptions. This proposed work is a new hybrid model that enhances drug safety prescriptions by taking into account individual patient features and drug interactions. It does this by hybrid attention mechanisms with Bayesian Decision Theory (BDT), which employs Bayesian statistical thinking instead of the dot-product approach. This approach is driven by the growing complexity of patient profiles and the limitations of current algorithms, which often fail to dynamically change the relevance of individual aspects. This method seeks 94% accuracy, effectively prioritizing safer drug combinations and personalizing drug recommendations. This integration leads to more consistent and customized drug prescriptions, which ultimately improve patient outcomes and advance the field of personalized healthcare.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on Recess Gated Fe-Doped AlN/GaN/AlGaN HEMT for Next Generation Broadband Power Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The effect of gate recess on DC/RF performance of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{L}_{\mathbf{G}}=200$</tex> nm AlN/GaN/AlGaN HEMT on SiC wafer is compared with the performance of the nonrecessed device. When compared to the non-recess HEMT structure, the L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">G</inf> = 200nm device has a substantial peak G<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</inf> of 1339 mS/mm & a peak I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</inf> of 3.29 A/mm at 2nm recess depth. The results also revealed the trade-off between positive shift of V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</inf> and output drain current beyond 2nm recess depth. Besides recess depth, the work function-dependent performance of the device is explored at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{L}_{\mathbf{rec}}=2\mathbf{nm}$</tex>, an optimal recess depth. The simulation results show that electrical characteristics are dependent on the work function of gate metal. Finally, the investigation carried out to examine the effects of Fe-doped AlGaN buffer showed excellent DC/RF characteristics. When compared with the undoped AlGaN buffer, the Fe-doped AlGaN buffer device exhibited the highest I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</inf> of 3.48 A/mm, & peak G<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</inf> of 1336 mS/mm, and an <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{f}_{\mathbf{T}}$</tex> of 69.8 GHz. articleTitle: Wireless Gesture-Driven Navigation for Autonomous Robots: An Innovative Human-Machine Interface Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: As more and more features are added to the car's Human- Machine Interface (HMI), device management becomes increasingly difficult. Making the most of the many human senses is consequently a tactic to facilitate using in-car technologies. With the use of an Arduino Uno and this concept, a car robot with wireless navigation can be built. The robot chassis's direction is altered in accordance with the statement specified in the Arduino code, which is run when the position of the hand is monitored and the designed coordinates are taken into consideration as the parameter. in order for it to carry out the necessary actions, such as going ahead, backward, turning left, turning right, and stopping.

articleTitle: OptiFarm: An ANT Colony-Optimized Deep Learning System for Precision Crop Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Machine learning-powered crop recommendation systems have transformed agriculture by offering data-driven insights into the best crops to farm. Since the SVM algorithm performs admirably in forecasting appropriate crop suggestions given soil quality, weather, and other previous crop data, it has virtually been employed with the current system up to this point. However, because long-term dependencies emerge in data, the LSTM algorithm is significantly more effective and precise at forecasting general trends. In order to improve crop suggestions, LSTM relies on leveraging temporal relationships, particularly inside sequences where trends and patterns are preserved in chronological data. Additionally, by evaluating the dataset to forecast areas with the highest prospective production, Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) helps determine the most lucrative farming places. The total efficacy of crop recommendation systems is greatly increased by the suggested mix of cutting-edge machine learning approaches, allowing farmers to optimize output and profitability.

articleTitle: Intelligent Defect Detection Using Machine Learning to Improve Fabric Quality Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The fabric defect identification process is a tedious and time-consuming process that involves multiple human work-forces to reduce the time consumption and to reduce human involvement we propose a novel approach applying Machine Learning techniques to identify the defects in fabric material. As per the global marketing data the textile business grows approximately 5 % to 6 % every year and reaches a maximum of one trillion dollars annually. With such a huge income-based industry the involvement of manual defect identification in fabrics is not cost efficient and defect identification efficiency is low. To overcome all these factors Machine Learning Algorithm are applied. We use a One-Class Support Vector Machine (OCSVM) to classify the defects based on features such as color intensity and design pattern. It automatically detects the defects in fabric by applying binarization and feature extraction techniques. These two techniques provide a rapid identification of defects in the fabric when compared to human identification with an accuracy more than 95%.

articleTitle: Brilliant Wristband for Multi-Sensory Impaired People
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: By considering communication issues, multisensory people frequently live alone and face serious problems confined to a small world. In this paper, communication equipment that allows people to communicate with one another is constructed by small, cheap, and inexpensive components. One of the significant benefits is the system's ability to communicate with blind people without requiring braille knowledge. The brilliant band translates the Braille alphabet into the English language. By pressing the arranged push button switches on the Brilliant-Band, the multisensory user can compose a text message. The other mobile user then receives the message via Bluetooth. Through the use of tiny vibration motors at the back end of the band, the Brilliant Band can also receive incoming messages, enabling blind persons to see the alphabet.

articleTitle: Smart Detection of Underground Cable Faults Using Arduino and Bluetooth Integrating
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Efficient detection of underground cable faults is vital for the uninterrupted operation of electrical grids. This paper presents an innovative solution for smart underground cable fault detection using Arduino and Bluetooth integration. The system utilizes multiple sensors to monitor key parameters such as voltage, resistance, and temperature variations to accurately detect and localize faults in real-time. By automating the fault detection process, the system enables rapid fault localization, eliminating the need for traditional manual inspections and reducing complex setups. The system logs GPS coordinates of detected faults and transmits them via Bluetooth, enabling maintenance teams to locate faults quickly. Bluetooth technology allows wireless data transmission to mobile devices, offering convenient access to fault data for maintenance teams, thereby enhancing operational efficiency. The integration of cost-effective Arduino technology and portable Bluetooth connectivity makes the system scalable and suitable for widespread deployment in various grid infrastructures. This novel approach significantly reduces downtime, improves fault management, and provides an efficient, low-cost solution for modern power distribution networks.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Techniques for Weather Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Human activities are directly impacted by weather occurrences. Forest fires, high air temperatures that lead to drought, and extreme weather events caused by global warming all make life more difficult for humans. Precautions against such climatic calamities require weather forecast models that are both accurate and effective. As a result, creating models that accurately forecast the weather is crucial. The creation of effective models of deep learning-based weather forecasting was greatly aided by technological advancements. This study suggested a hybrid weather prediction model based on convolutional and recurrent neural networks, which had a decent success rate. The dataset named Jena, which comprises 14 parameters, extensive meteorological information that has not been used for predicting the weather, was subjected to the suggested hybrid model. The experimental findings were compared using well-known machine learning, deep learning, and statistical techniques such CNN, Integrated Moving Average with Auto-Regression, LSTM, RNN, Random Forest, Multilayer Perceptrons and SVM. These comparisons showed that the suggested hybrid model had the best prediction outcome across the board. For instance, the suggested hybrid model produced the following findings based on the weather forecast data for Jena.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Fruit Harvest and Quality Control System (Agripick)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In recent years, the integration of deep learning technologies in agriculture has shown significant potential for enhancing efficiency and productivity. This paper presents a novel fruit picking and quality analysis system that leverages deep learning techniques to automate the harvesting process and assess fruit quality in real-time. Utilizing a combination of image processing and deep learning, the system analyzes visual attributes such as color, texture, and shape to evaluate fruit quality. The proposed solution not only reduces labor costs and minimizes waste but also ensures that only high-quality produce reaches consumers. Experimental results demonstrate high accuracy rates in fruit detection and quality assessment, showcasing the effectiveness of deep learning in agricultural applications. This system represents a significant advancement toward smart farming, contributing to sustainable agricultural practices and improved supply chain efficiency.

articleTitle: Design of a Modified I Shaped Reconfigurable Patch Antenna for Multiband Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Compact modified I shaped reconfigurable patch antenna is designed for multiband applications. Square split rings are augmented to the rectangular microstrip antenna to enhance the performance of the antenna. Three PIN diodes with different switching states are actuated for producing reconfigurable resonant bands. The SRR antenna with all the diodes OFF produced a wide band resonance with a bandwidth of 700 MHz and the ring resonator is responsible for this wide resonance. Eleven reconfigurable bands are produced by the modified I shaped patch for different switching states of the three PIN diodes. The antenna produced a maximum gain of 3.98dB when all the diodes were ON and a minimum gain of 1.46dB when all the diodes were OFF which indicates that losses associated with the diodes are less. Four 5G NR reconfigurable bands such as N38, N79, N46 and N48 are obtained for the first three switching cases of the diodes. Seven reconfigurable bands suitable for earth exploration, meteorological satellite, radionavigation, maritime and aeronautical mobile, broadcasting and international broadcast stations is obtained for the switching conditions of all the three diodes.

articleTitle: Cloud Based Secure Interoperability of Electronic Health Records Sharing by Using Clinical Document Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: One of the hardest parts of cloud computing is protection. The successful implementation of digital fitness reporting aims to protect those impacted by growth and deliver priority care, but it requires interoperability between multiple health information exchanges. hospital. Even when larger hospitals take over the sorting of CDA records, a task arises when statistics are scattered across many files that are difficult to manage. The security of statistics is not always guaranteed. In this article, we explain the security capabilities of the fully cloud-based CDA enrollment technology and integration service, allowing hospitals to quickly create and modify CDA files. To encrypt/decrypt statistics between shutdown utilities and network/software servers, the 128-bit Advanced Encryption Standard (AES-128) uses lookup keys: community lookup key and alert lookup key. Mutual authentication, confidentiality, and message integrity are all elements of the proposed medical information exchange technique. Session hijacking, square injection, and brute force attacks are also prevented.

articleTitle: Design and Material Optimization of BLDC Motor Windings using FEM for Motor-Pump Applications using Existing Stator Stamping
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This paper covers the design of a 1 Hp, 48 V brushless DC (BLDC) motor-pump utilizing an existing V4 stator stamping. The conceptual BLDC motor design is simulated by choosing different winding configuration and material options, where the number of turns also changed. An analytical approach specifically suited to pumping applications is proposed. Detailed scrutiny of the BLDC motor is carried out based on Finite Element Method (FEM) incorporating sustainable design practices. Simulations of magnetic flux distribution in Infolytica MagNet 7.1 are executed to determine the output characteristics. BLDC motors at 48 V corresponds to an efficiency of 94.06% produced power is 745 W. Torque maximum and speeds corresponded at 7.16 Nm and 3000 rpm whereas cogging torque is 0.74 Nm. The motor's efficiency and stable speed improve overall conversion efficiency by 6% in operational limits, confirming the proposed BLDC motor-pump is energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Elevating Medical Training: A Synergistic Fusion of AI and VR for Immersive Anatomy Learning and Practical Procedure Mastery
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Virtual reality with its 3D visualization have brought an overwhelming change in the face of medical education, especially for courses like human anatomy. The proposed virtual reality system to bring massive improvements in the education received by a medical student studying for their degree courses. The project puts forward the text-to-speech and speech-to-text aligned system that simplifies the usage of a chatbot empowered by OpenAI GPT-4 and allows pupils to vocally speak with Avatar, the set virtual assistant. Contrary to the current methodologies, the setup of virtual reality is powered by avatars and thus covers an enhanced virtual assistant environment. Avatars offer students the set of repeated practicing of medical procedures on it, and the real uniqueness in the proposed product. The developed virtual reality environment is enhanced over other current training techniques where a student should interact and immerse in three-dimensional human organs for visualization in three dimensions and hence get better knowledge of the subjects in greater depth. A virtual assistant guides the whole process, giving insights and support to help the student bridge the gap from theory to practice. Then, the system is essentially Knowledge based and Analysis based approach. The combination of generative AI along with embodied virtual agents has great potential when it comes to customized virtual conversation assistant for much wider range of applications. The study brings out the value of acquiring hands-on skills through simulated medical procedures and opens new frontiers of research and development in AI, VR, and medical education. In addition to assessing the effectiveness of such novel functionalities, the study also explores user experience related dimensions such as usability, task loading, and the sense of presence in proposed virtual medical environment.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Plant Health: A Cutting-Edge Approach to Leaf Disease Detection, Classification and Severity Estimation Through Advanced Image Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In the realm of agriculture, an array of diseases arises from pests and fungi, often necessitating manual identification, a process both time-intensive and prone to inaccuracies. The study advocates for the automation of leaf disease detection through the application of machine learning and image processing. The aim is to alleviate the manual burden associated with monitoring plant leaf conditions. The proposed method entails automated plant leaf disease detection and classification, leveraging image processing and machine learning techniques. Additionally, disease severity estimation is integrated to regulate pesticide usage. The implementation of this approach is slated for MATLAB, harnessing the capabilities of the image processing toolbox and machine learning toolbox.

articleTitle: Knee Osteoarthritis Based X- Ray Images Detection and Classification Using RCNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Osteoarthritis is the most common disease that affects joints, and its presentation mainly occurs among the aged population. Although an appropriate diagnosis of OA has been determinant in avoiding drastic progression in joint deterioration, the presently available radiographic methods depend on personal judgment. This paper proposes a deep learning-based CNN model for the automatic detection and classification of OA stages from knee X-ray images. The model was trained and tested on the OAI dataset and achieved a satisfactory accuracy of 99%. Advanced image preprocessing techniques, such as contrast enhancement and knee joint segmentation, were used to optimize the performance of the model. Extensive evaluation metrics, such as confusion matrices and ROC curves, confirmed the robustness of the proposed model. The results suggest the promise of AI systems in reinforcing clinical decision-making processes, especially in the early detection of OA. We also present ethical considerations within the applications of AI to healthcare, discussing future research directions.

articleTitle: Centralized HMI for Decentralized PLCs in Industrial Lighting Management using IoT Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Standardization is essential for any technological advancement to have widespread adoption, ensure interoperability, enhance compatibility and create a consistent user experience across various platforms and sectors. In industries, Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) and Human-Machine Interfaces (HMIs) play a crucial role in automating processes, improving operational efficiency, ensuring safety and providing real-time monitoring and control. The evolution of the Internet of Things (IoT) has significantly improved the industrial automation process to a higher level by enhancing the connectivity and data-sharing capabilities of PLCs and HMIs, enabling predictive maintenance and remote management. To meet the increasing demand and seamless integration of diverse industrial devices, many modern PLCs have built-in support for IoT implementation (IoT-ready PLCs) using industrial communication protocols like Ethernet Industrial Protocol (Ethernet/IP), PROFINET, Modbus, etc., with a standard interface. On the other hand, many old PLCs (legacy PLCs) continue to remain influential in industrial automation, managing complex processes. However, they lack built-in support for IoT integration due to different communication interfaces, proprietary protocols, and obsolete technology. Interconnecting these legacy PLCs under a shared network for data exchange, diagnosis, and remote monitoring in the industrial setup is challenging. It demands a huge capital expenditure to replace the existing legacy PLC infrastructure with IoT-ready PLCs. This challenge needs to be addressed through standardization and middleware solutions. This paper presents the integration of different PLCs deployed at diverse locations for the Industrial Lighting Management System (LMS) with a centralized HMI through a shared network using IoT Technologies.

articleTitle: Abnormal Event Recognition is Surveillance using Multibranch- Generative Adversial Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The detection of abnormal events in surveillance footage is crucial for public safety and security in various environments. Traditional methods, which often rely on human monitoring, are time-consuming and prone to error. Real- time anomaly detection can now be automated through deep learning technologies. Automated anomaly identification is made possible by Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), an effective method for video analysis. This project introduces a novel approach using a Multi- Branch GAN (M-GAN) model specifically designed for detecting anomalies in surveillance video. The M-GAN model employs a two-stage process, learning the distribution of normal events and Identifying deviations as potential anomalies. Its key advantage is its ability to operate without labelled anomaly data, adapting more flexibly to various environments and conditions. Experimental results show that the M-GAN outperforms conventional GAN- based methods, achieving higher precision and recall rates in detecting abnormal events. This robust performance positions M-GAN as a leading solution for real- time abnormal event detection in surveillance systems, promising to enhance safety and security while reducing the need for extensive manual oversight.

articleTitle: Improving Diagnostic Accuracy: Hybrid DeepLearning Model for Oral cancer Identification in Neuroimaging
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Oral cancer is a significant health menace as it accounts for many deaths. This is due to the fact that the majority of cases are diagnosed in advanced stages. The timely intervention in case of any diagnosis of oral cancer or any potential pre-cancerous lesions is likely to have better outcomes and reduce the costs incurred in treatment. This review scrutinizes the presently available diagnostic methods which include clinical examination, imaging, molecular approach and other new technologies that are on the way. The article further explores limitations of these approaches and discusses future prospects in diagnosis, especially the part that addresses the need to improve early diagnosis methods. Overall, oral cancer continues to be a significant burden on the health of populations and to improve peoples' outcomes early diagnosis is of utmost importance. It cannot be overemphasized the changes brought about in medical imaging by the advent of deep learning techniques which offer promising solutions for oral cancer detection and classification. One does not need to wait to diagnose this condition and so early identification is imperative. Nevertheless, fundamentals of traditional early diagnosis depend entirely on human skills hence are limited. Various research studies have explored deep learning architecture for different tasks in the diagnosis and classification of oral cancer such as lesion detection, segmentation, and characterization.

articleTitle: Detecting Leaf Diseases Using Centralized CNN'S with Efficient R-CNN and Mask R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Plant diseases have emerged as a significant concern, as they can drastically reduce both the quality and quantity of agricultural products. The research aims to identify plant leaf infections early on, enabling timely treatment to prevent the spread of diseases to other plants. The objective is to determine the severity of leaf diseases, allowing for targeted treatment based on the level of severity. Additionally, the severity of leaf diseases can help predict crop losses. This work is to improve the accuracy of leaf detection and measurement of morphological traits by Region Convolutional Neural Network (RCNN), Network namely state of the Mask region art. Experimental results verify that our automated approach effectively segments leaves from different plant families. Measured leaves of comparable size have an average relative error of about 4.6 percent for leaf length and approximately 5.7 percent for leaf width when compared to manual measurements by expert ecologists and botanists.

articleTitle: Model Compression by EL-XAI in IoMT Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: IoMT systems are evolving at a higher rate than other IoT applications. As health is of major concern, more health monitoring sensors and devices are incorporated which helps in the well-being of the people at their comfort zone. The IoMT system needs highly capable sensors and devices to know the exact information of the patients from the remote area. On the other hand, usage of high-resolution devices leads to the higher amount of data packets for communication purposes. This increases the workload of the cloud server that can be faced using compression algorithms. This paper proposes the compression technique for various datasets because the medical devices produce different data format outputs. So, it is difficult for the cloud server to understand and interpret the information from the IoMT devices. Therefore, this paper uses an Explainable Artificial Intelligence based Ensemble learning algorithm using Lempel Ziv, 2D and 3D wavelet compression techniques in the cloud server of the IoMT system. The proposed system utilizes the resource efficiently and shown good results in terms of accuracy, throughput, and storage saving. The results are compared with the conventional EL algorithm to study the proposed system performance.

articleTitle: Improving Energy Efficiency in Electric Vehicle Machine Drives Through MRAC Tuned DT Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: An analysis of current market trends and environmental imperatives clearly indicate that electric vehicles (EVs) are emerging to dominate the future of the automotive industry. Enhancing the energy efficiency of EVs has become a critical priority to optimize performance, extend range, and reduce overall energy consumption. This necessitates the deployment of advanced control strategies, such as the implementation of an optimized Direct Torque Control (DTC) technique tuned by Model Reference Adaptive Controller (MRAC), throughout the drivetrain system to regulate the machine drive's operation under varying operational conditions. The machine drive is powered by a battery pack connected to a bidirectional DC-DC converter. Recharging of the battery is done through the implementation of regenerative braking. The machine drive is governed by an inverter circuit whose operation is managed using the MRAC-DTC method. The key feature distinguishing the MRAC-DTC is its ability to control the speed and flux as the drive accelerates or decelerates using DTC while delivering the necessary torque to the load by leveraging MRAC's adaptability.

articleTitle: Differential Region-Based Segmentation Method for Brain Tumor Detection using Computed Tomography Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Brain malignant growth detection is eased using medical images and machine learning paradigms. This article introduces a differential region-based segmentation method to improve brain tumor detection precision from computerized tomography inputs. The proposed method relies on neural networks for different region detection and segmentation. The neural network is trained using the different connecting regional conditions. Based on the learning iterations the region matching conditions are verified to ensure maximum segments are identified. Thus this proposed method improves accuracy and precision by 15.48% and 12.59% for the different features.

articleTitle: MCTC: An Approach Based on Redundancy Spotting Through Overlapping Regions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Every IoT devices revolves around the challenges of optimizing power usage to ensure prolonged device operation and longer battery life. This encompasses addressing issues such as latency, excessive data transmission, all of which impacts the sustainability and effectiveness of IoT devices in various applications. This paper aims at optimizing power usage which is a crucial component for IoT devices, especially those running on batteries. There are various advancing algorithms that are emerging in the current era for finding the overlapping regions. This paper uses a new technique called as MCTC by considering a certain geographical area and further the overlapping region of the homogeneous sensor nodes are found. A simulation tool is used for finding the overlapping regions. Then further, the redundant data is removed by simply combining the useful data. Finally, the results of modified algorithm are compared to the existing algorithm to exhibit the enhanced efficiency along with increased accuracy of the data through the MCTC algorithm. By removing redundant data, the processing time and storage taken by these redundant data is eliminated through which the efficiency of the cloud computing is improved.

articleTitle: IoT and AI for Real-Time Customer Behavior Analysis in Digital Banking
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This research tracks and evaluates consumer use of several online banking systems using Electrical gadgets that are linked together and use artificial intelligence (AI) and the internet of things (IoT). Banks could be able to get a lot of data about how consumers engage with them, what they like, and what they purchase by means of Internet of Things (IoT) sensors in smartphones, wearable electronics, and other linked products. This data can be rapidly handled and examined using cutting-edge Machine learning (ML) and natural language processing (NLP) are two types of AI. Therefore providing insightful analysis on customer behaviour. Armed with this knowledge, financial institutions will be more adept in spotting frauds, simplifying procedures, reducing risks, and customer service enhancement. This paper investigates the use of artificial intelligence and the Internet of Things to examine consumer behaviour in digital banking as it is right now as well as potential issues and benefits. This approach of doing things might revolutionise the banking industry and enable companies to gradually establish closer bonds with their customers.

articleTitle: Survival Prediction for Patients with Cirrhosis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Cirrhosis is one of the major causes of death around the world. Hence, the possibility of survival prediction among patients affected by this disease constitutes the principal factor in properly planning treatment and management procedures. This work aims to design a predictive model of the probability of survival of patients who have cirrhosis based on patient data, including clinical parameters, medical history, and laboratory findings of these patients. The data-driven machine learning algorithm improves the predictive accuracy and significantly enhances the clinical decision-making process. This considers multiple predictors: the patient's liver function tests, the demographic factors, and the indicators of disease progression in the body. It will be validated for reliability and accuracy using real-world patient case data. Therefore, this tool could aid clinicians in devising treatment plans that improve patient outcomes and efficiently utilise healthcare resources. This study also contributes to the emerging genre of AI-assisted care because chronic liver disease management, specifically cirrhosis, in this case, requires constituting predictive analytics.

articleTitle: Context-Aware Remote Patient Monitoring System with IoT and Digital Security
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The “Context Awar Remote Patient Monitoring System with IoT and Digital Security” revolutionizes continuous healthcare by integrating IoT technology, sensors, and cloud computing to address the growing need for effective at-home patient monitoring. This system ensures vital health data is continuously recorded, analyzed, and made available to healthcare professionals in real-time. At its core is the Node MCU microcontroller, which connects key sensors to a cloud-based platform. The SPO2 sensor measures blood oxygen saturation to detect issues like hypoxemia, while the body temperature sensor tracks core temperature, signaling possible infections or fevers. An environmental temperature sensor monitors ambient conditions, crucial for patients with chronic illnesses or weakened immunity. Data is securely transmitted to the cloud for analysis using machine learning algorithms. These tools cross-reference vital and environmental data to detect health anomalies and predict early illness onset. For example, a drop in oxygen levels combined with a fever triggers alerts for potential respiratory infections, empowering healthcare providers to intervene promptly and prevent complications. This system's predictive capabilities and real-time alerts ensure timely responses to critical thresholds, enhancing patient safety and reducing hospital admissions. A user-friendly interface allows patients and caregivers to monitor health trends via mobile and web applications. By enabling continuous, remote monitoring, this solution benefits patients with chronic conditions, the elderly, and post-surgery individuals, providing peace of mind and reducing the workload on healthcare facilities. It promotes high-quality care from the comfort of patients' homes, aligning with modern telehealth needs. In conclusion, the “Context Awar Remote Patient Monitoring System with IoT and Digital Security” is a transformative tool for remote care, combining advanced sensor technology, real-time analytics, and machine learning to deliver improved outcomes, resource efficiency, and patient-centered healthcare.

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis of Cyberbullying on X Data using Multi-Model Supervised Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Cyberbullying predictive analysis on Twitter data has garnered considerable attention owing to the escalating prevalence of harmful online behavior. This study proposes a novel approach utilizing a multi- model supervised technique to predict instances of cyberbullying on Twitter. The proposed technique aims to bolster the accuracy and effectiveness of cyberbullying detection by amalgamating textual, social, and network features. Twitter data sets containing both cyberbullying and non-cyberbullying instances are used to train and evaluate the models. The textual features include sentiment analysis, bag-of-words, and semantic similarity, while the social features encompass user characteristics, such as follower count and account age. Network features involve analyzing the user's network structure and interaction patterns. Machine learning (ML) algorithms such as random forests (RF), support vector machines (SVM), and neural networks (NN), are utilized to construct and assess models. The Experimental results show that the combined approach achieves improved performance in effective prediction compared with individual models. The study also emphasizes the importance of feature selection in improving model accuracy. By accurately identifying cyberbullying incidents on Twitter, this research contributes to the development of effective strategies and countermeasures to mitigate the harmful effects of cyberbullying.

articleTitle: Harnessing Blockchain and Deep Learning for Enhanced Energy Analytics in Photovoltaic Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The rapid evolution of solar energy in industrial sectors has sparked a growing interest in renewable energy, particularly within the context of smart grids and systems. The effective detection and management of energies within photovoltaic (PV) systems stand as crucial tasks in this landscape. This abstract introduces a proposed model aimed at exploring the integration of blockchain networks within large-scale solar energy infrastructures. The primary objective is to establish a framework that enables the distribution of solar energy in a decentralized manner to end-users while ensuring secure energy transactions between producers and consumers. Blockchain technology serves as the cornerstone of this model, encompassing intelligent techniques to address energy mitigation challenges within the solar energy network. By leveraging blockchain, the detection of energies within solar power plants becomes shared knowledge accessible to all users connected to the solar power network. The research within this framework emphasizes the exploration and application of diverse Deep Learning (DL) architectures, including autoencoders, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, Deep Stacking Networks (DSNs), and Deep Belief Networks (DBNs). Furthermore, this research extends beyond conventional machine learning approaches, incorporating knowledge-driven methodologies.
