It incorporates generative models such as adversarial networks and transfer learning, elevating the scope of machine learning in optimizing energy detection, distribution, and consumption within the block chain-based solar energy infrastructure. This interdisciplinary approach signifies a significant stride in fortifying renewable energy systems. By amalgamating blockchain's decentralized nature with sophisticated DL architectures and knowledge-driven models, it establishes a resilient and efficient renewable energy infrastructure capable of meeting escalating demands for sustainable energy solutions.

articleTitle: Enhanced On-Chip Memory Reliability for Space Engineering using a Novel 2-Dimensional Error Detection and Correction Scheme
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The paper presents a novel error detection and correction (EDAC) scheme tailored for space engineering applications, which aims to enhance the reliability of on-chip memory under challenging environmental conditions, including cosmic radiation and extreme temperatures. The proposed 2-dimensional code employs a divide-symbol strategy, utilizing XOR operations to encode diagonal, parity, and check bits during the encoding process. The decoding process is sophisticated, incorporating syndrome calculation and region selection to effectively identify and rectify errors. Simulation results obtained using Xilinx Vivado demonstrates that the proposed scheme achieves low power consumption and minimal area utilization compared to existing methods. Specifically, the encoder exhibits a maximum and minimum delay of 128 endpoints, with resource utilization metrics showing 0.02% LUT, 0.03% FF, and 25% IO utilization. The decoder exhibits a maximum and minimum delay of 64 endpoints, with resource utilization metrics of 0.03% LUT, 0.02% FF, and 19% IO utilization. This innovative EDAC methodology offers a promising solution for improving memory reliability in space applications, particularly by addressing issues caused by multiple cell upsets induced by radiation. The scheme's advantages, including enhanced memory reliability, reduced power consumption, and minimal area utilization, position it as a potentially valuable tool for future space engineering projects.

articleTitle: Privacy-Secure and Decentralized Biometric Authentication Models Using Federated Learning Frameworks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: A biometric identifier, in contrast to other identifiers used for authentication, is a quantitative evaluation of an individual's physical attributes that is successfully used to confirm or validate the identification. Because of its remarkable and consistent texture variation, iris recognition is thought to be the most dependable biometric recognition. Concerns about security, authentication, and identification are growing in importance across all domains as technology advances daily. High-security applications use these unique patterns for iris recognition. To increase the security of biometric applications without jeopardizing individual privacy, this research suggests a novel FL technique for privacy-preserving iris detection. Traditional biometric systems rely on centralised data storage and processing, which threatens data security and misuse. Federated Learning: decentralized model training that allows multiple federated clients (like mobile devices or edge servers) to collaboratively train a global model without sharing their raw iris data. We explore how this architecture can be applied to iris detection systems, maintaining accuracy while mitigating privacy risks. Our method ensures that iris features are learned locally on individual devices, and only encrypted model updates are shared with the central server. To strengthen privacy, we incorporate differential privacy and secure aggregation techniques to prevent data leakage during model training. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework in maintaining high detection accuracy, low communication overhead, and robust privacy guarantees.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis of Portable Solar Stove Using Thermo Electric Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The solar stove is pollution free and efficient so it consumes less power energy which makes it less economical. The solar energy available in abundance and over 90% of is not been utilized. Since the solar energy is available throughout the day so that this system is efficient. This paper presents solar-powered thermoelectric stove utilizing a Thermo-Electric Controller (TEC) diode for both heating and cooling purposes, although this paper focuses on heating applications. The TEC diode is used to cool the photovoltaic (PV) cells, enhancing system efficiency, power capacity, and lifespan. The solar energy harvested is used to operate the stove, with a micro-controller managing the heating process. A temperature sensor monitors the TEC diode to automatically switch off the stove upon reaching maximum temperature. The compact design makes it suitable for applications such as travel, military, medical, and aerospace uses, providing a dual-purpose stove that operates on solar power during the day and battery power at night.

articleTitle: Identification of Medicinal Plants Using Image Processing and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Plant recognition is both an indispensable and significant autecological method to botany taxonomy, which would combine recent advancements in Machine Learning with botanical science. In this study, medicinal plant identification was studied as primary because it plays a major role in the pharmaceutical sector. We also study other machine-learning approaches besides image processing methods to extract leaf features. The implemented system aims to provide timely, precise classification of medicinal plants. Indian leaf species were identified through Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) as a NET framework. The Guided Active Contour method also allows for simplification of leaf segmentation. The results from the trials showed accuracy similar to when traditional machine learning methods are used. This study would offer a feasible way to decrease human labor in pharmacognosy research and the botanical industry, enhance productivity, and automatically identify medicinal plants.

articleTitle: IoT-Based DroolSense for Cerebral Palsy Patients
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Excessive drooling or sialorrhea is a serious condition caused by cerebral palsy in patients. Dehydration, aspiration pneumonia, and potential skin infections result from it. To manage this condition and stop further health deterioration, early detection of the said condition and swift management are required. Here, we present DroolSense as an Internet of Things solution for real-time monitoring and identification of excessive drooling. DroolSense is a proactive approach to drooling management, and it ensures timely interventions because it sends alerts to caregivers on mobile phones. Since the system removes the risks that come with unchecked drooling, it has been very reliable and may even help patients who will end up with better care. Future work will examine predictive analytics and better integration into sophisticated health monitoring systems further to advance its capabilities in telemedicine and home healthcare settings.

articleTitle: Crop for Est - Crop Forecasting and Estimation. Crop Yield Estimation and Profitability Analysis for Precision Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The agriculture industry significantly contributes to the nation's economy by employing a large segment of the population and enhancing the GDP. It is a primary source of livelihood for many people, particularly in rural areas. India's agricultural sector is known for its diversity, producing a wide range of crops including rice, wheat pulses, sugarcane, cotton, fruits, and vegetables. This industry faces a significant challenge in predicting crop yield production and crop demand accurately. Efforts have been made to address these challenges through various government initiatives such as subsidies and continued investment in agricultural research and development. The traditional methods of predicting crop yield and market demand is cumbersome and time consuming and is susceptible to errors, resulting in inefficient resource utilization and revenue losses. There is a need for predicting the most efficient crop based on various influential environmental markers and forecasting the profitability. This project aims to develop an intelligent platform that uses machine learning algorithms to estimate the crop for cultivation in each area based on environmental factors. The project also aims to forecast market demand and pricing trends for the identified crop with the aim of increasing the profitability for the farmers and other stakeholders in the agriculture industry.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning for Anticipating Chip Failure Rates in VLSI Design
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to investigate the incorporation of machine literacy techniques for the prediction of chip failure rates in the design of veritably Large Scale Integration (VLSI) systems. The complexity of very large-scale integrated circuits (VLSI) is increasing as semiconductor technology progresses, which presents issues in terms of their ability to be trusted. When it comes to dealing with the complexities of ultramodern chip infrastructures, traditional methods of failure rate prediction typically see a dramatic decline. The purpose of this is to improve the accuracy and precision of failure rate forecasts by analysing a wide range of elements, including design specifications, environmental factors, and manufacturing variables. This will be accomplished through the utilization of machine literacy algorithms. Our method tries to discover patterns and dependencies that contribute to chip failures using extensive data analysis and model training. As a result, it provides suppliers with a valuable instrument that can be used to proactively solve implicit trust ability issues during the VLSI design process. Within the constantly shifting landscape of semiconductor technology, the findings of this investigation present a potentially fruitful path toward the improvement of the reliability of very large-scale integrated circuits (VLSI) and the enhancement of the trustworthiness of electronic systems.

articleTitle: Wireless Electrical Equipment Monitoring System for Energy Auditing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This paper is to detect the energy wasted by the electrical appliances and identify the inefficient appliances. The amount of energy used by all the heavy load electrical appliances is measured by using data acquisition device and is transmitted to the data computation device for computation and comparison of efficiency of the appliances which is helpful to identify the inefficient electrical appliance. The energy auditing of the electrical appliances can also be carried out automatically. The objective of this project is to decrease the energy loss that is caused due to existing system of energy auditing and conserve energy by proper monitoring of appliance's efficiency and also to monitor the average hourly, daily, monthly and yearly energy usage of each load connected to the system.

articleTitle: Air Quality Monitoring on Congested Roads Using Smart Sensor Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Rapid industrialization and urbanization, especially in a densely populated area, have resulted in air pollution in Chennai, which presents serious issues. The city's economic expansion has resulted in a rise in emissions from several sources, which hurts the environment, public health, and infrastructure. To solve this, a sophisticated system for monitoring air quality has been created. It combines GPS, wireless GIS, and solid-state gas sensor technology into portable devices, making it possible to effectively identify and measure air contaminants. According to real- time data gathered from several sites, severe carbon monoxide levels have been found. Readings are as high as 0.00045 % in Anna Nagar, 0.00043% in Tambaram, and 0.00029% close to the airport and railway station. There are levels of 0.00021% and 0.00022% in other places, like Chrompet and Ashok Pillar. This thorough monitoring strategy to improves the capacity to control and lessen pollution.

articleTitle: AMBU-BOT: Effective Accident Preventive System Using IOT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This paper intends to propose a new robot which overcomes the hurdles of an AED(Automated External Defibrillator) at the nearest Ambubot: A robot, ambulance robot designed and developed that carries an AED for assisting lay rescuers to save patients' lives, as well as Time taken before the ambulance is located in the case of a sudden cardiac arrest. The working of Ambubot could go searching for the victims and also obedient to the human instructions. Population is growing daily, and with it, so is the risk of heart disease also increasing. Even though traffic on our roads is normal for people, it is crucial to admit heart attack victims to hospitals in case of emergency because it can be easy for them to receive an automated external defibrillator at such a young age. Its independent purpose is to save the sufferer.

articleTitle: Analysis of Factors Impacting the Efficiency of EEG- Based Biometric Authentication System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Biometric authentication deals with the verifying identity based on physical and behavioural biometric traits of an individual. To prevent against the imposter attack, biometric modalities for person recognition is necessary. The biometrics traits like voice, speech, face, fingerprint recognition systems are commonly used and they are very effective. The disadvantage while using a traditional biometric feature is that they can be easily trapped and deceived. Brain-computer interface is the rapid developing technology, as a new biometric trait., EEG signal has been extensively concerned in recent times. The fact that electroencephalogram signals are distinctive and considerably more challenging to replicate than traditional biometrics which motivated for utilizing them. Indeed, by employing EEG signals obtained from brainiac processes, current user authentication security risks like shoulder surfing can be addressed., offers a novel solution to current security issues involving traditional knowledge-based user identification. In this paper, the objective is to analyze the research work on the EEG based authentication system based on experimental arrangement for users like EEG-acquisition protocols (e.g.., rest, external stimuli driven, mental, and hybrid), utilization of artificial intelligence methodologies and the considerations for security and privacy preservation. The papers examined a wide range of experiment protocols and various algorithms for EEG signal classification. Furthermore, this paper compares various classification and validation techniques. It also focuses on the efficient and effective EEG-based User Authentication techniques., and all the unholding privacy.

articleTitle: An Advanced Brain Tumour Detection Framework Using Improved Fast Mask R-CNN Techniques for Enhanced Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: To enhance the precision of diagnosis, this research provides a new structure for identifying brain tumors that integrates an Improved Fast Mask Region based Convolutional Neural Network (IFMRCNN) with complex image processing algorithms. Identification of brain tumors is still a significant difficulty in medical imaging since successful therapy depends on early and accurate identification. By precisely identifying tumor boundaries in brain MRI scans, the proposed model makes use of an enhanced version of FMRCNN is intended to enhance separating and categorizing performance. Sophisticated image processing methods are used to improve the extraction of features, allowing the model to more accurately differentiate between tumor and non-tumor areas. By lowering false positives and true negatives, the structure seeks to maintain computing power while greatly increasing detection rates. The proposed strategy outperforms conventional techniques in terms of reliability, specificity, and sensitivity, according to the results of experiments, which makes it a viable tool for support with clinical choices as well as initial diagnosis in neuroimaging. IFRCNN was applied using the Open CV package in conjunction with an SVM algorithm. Using 218 photos as an initial training set, this study's approach demonstrated a 100% success rate in classifying meningiomas and 87.5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> accuracy in classifying gliomas, with an average conviction score of 94.6% in the segments of meningioma tumors. A neurologist does a manual examination and ground truth assessment to verify the divided tumor areas

articleTitle: Deep Fake Detection Based on Hybrid Approach Involving Residual Network Deep Learning Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This Deep fake Technology aims at generating synthetic video content or morphed video content which is very realistic to the naked eye. It involves the use of deep learning algorithms in the domain of video processing. In most cases, such artificially generated video contents are very difficult to get differentiated from naturally captured video signals. The existing methodologies of detection involved image tamper detection and digital forensics algorithms. These algorithms are ineffective in detecting videos tampered using deep fake technology. The proposed technique involves training and building of deep learning models that works like a black box to detect the artefacts crucial in the detection of video tampering. This paper presents an overview of the technology advancements in the field of deep fake video detection techniques over recent years. This paper also performs a comparative analysis on the performance of hybrid algorithms involving residual network deep learning architecture in the detection of video signals morphed using deep fake technology. The training datasets are obtained from Face forensics to build the model. The algorithm is augmented with image quality assessment, temporal consistency analysis and facial landmarks analysis to improve the detection algorithm. The performance metrics involve the generation of confusion matrix and generation of accuracy measures. The results provide a promising direction towards the construction of better detection models to safeguard against current and future threats.

articleTitle: Hybrid Xception-ResNext BiLSTM Model with Attention and Visual Synchronization for Robust Deepfake Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Deepfake technology has become a significant problem since it allows for the creationof compelling manipulated videos. This research presents a novel hybrid deepfake detection system that combines the Xception and ResNext networks with a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) model and Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM). Apart from focusing on the temporal and spatial anomalies of deepfakes, our model also includes visual synchronization analysis and physiological signal detection. Extensive experiments are conducted across several datasets, exhibiting cutting-edge performance across various manipulation scenarios. The proposed method achieves good generalization, as they are in real-world circumstances.

articleTitle: Automated CKD Detection via Image Processing Employing Delta-E Metric and CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) is a global health concern that often progresses silently until advanced stages, making early detection critical. This paper presents a point-of-care system that automates the color comparison between a test strip and a reference strip to detect biomarkers like albumin associated with kidney dysfunction. The system leverages mobile-captured images, applying image processing techniques such as segmentation and color extraction, and compares the test strip's top color with reference colors on the parent strip using the Delta-E metric in the LAB color space. The closest match quantifies the biomarker concentration, providing a reliable diagnostic measure. To enhance diagnostic precision, this research incorporates Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to refine image preprocessing and anomaly detection. The CNN model complements existing methods by mitigating environmental influences like lighting variability and improving feature extraction accuracy. This hybrid approach ensures consistency while adapting to diverse datasets and image conditions. The result is a cost-effective, fast, and accessible diagnostic tool that reduces manual errors and supports early CKD detection in resource-limited settings. Future work will focus on expanding the application of this system to detect other diseases and further optimize the integration of CNNs for enhanced scalability and robustness.

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis and Classification of Commodity Market Trends Using Enhanced RNN with Economic Indicator
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving landscape of commodity markets, accurate forecasting and classification of price trends are crucial for informed decision-making by investors, traders, and policymakers. This study presents a novel predictive analysis framework utilizing an Enhanced Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) integrated with significant economic indicators to improve the accuracy of commodity market trend predictions. We leverage a comprehensive dataset comprising historical prices and various economic metrics, including inflation rates, interest rates, and geopolitical factors, sourced from Kaggle. The proposed Enhanced RNN architecture incorporates advanced techniques, such as attention mechanisms and dropout layers, to effectively capture the temporal dependencies and nonlinear relationships inherent in time-series data. By integrating economic indicators as additional features, our model gains a contextual understanding of market dynamics, allowing it to respond to fluctuations driven by economic conditions. We evaluate the performance of the Enhanced RNN against baseline models using metrics such as Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), and classification accuracy. The results demonstrate that our model significantly outperforms traditional forecasting methods, achieving higher prediction accuracy and robustness in volatile market scenarios. This research contributes to the field of business analytics by providing a sophisticated tool for commodity price forecasting, highlighting the importance of economic indicators in predictive modeling, and offering insights into future market trends.

articleTitle: LLM-Powered UPI Transaction Monitoring and Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In this Business World, the Unified Payments Interface (UPI) has transformed digital payments by facilitating instantaneous Business-to-Person (B2P) and Person-to-Person (P2P) transactions. But the quick expansion of UPI transactions has also drawn fraudsters. Current fraud detection systems are built on Machine Learning algorithms that have been trained on historical data and Rule-Based methodologies. Even if they work, these techniques can't keep up with changing fraud trends and can overlook new attack opportunities. The inflexibility and absence of Real-Time Natural Language understanding in current systems makes it difficult to assess user behaviour and spot false narratives. This study uses Large Language Models (LLM's) to provide a unique method of fraud detection and UPI transaction monitoring. After being trained on enormous text and code datasets, LLM's are able to discern suspicious patterns and narratives that point to fraud by analyzing transaction data, user messages, and social media interactions.

articleTitle: AI for Predicting Solar Flare and Study it's Effects on Earth's Temperature
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Solar flare one of the most discussing events in space science is intense bursts of electromagnetic radiations emitted from sun. This phenomena has significant impact on space weather and can influence various earths systems including atmospheric temperatures. Not only this solar radiations have severe impacts on satellite operations, communication system and power grids. This research paper aims to present novel approach for predicting solar flare using Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) architectures. In the paper we have proposed Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks and Gated Recurrent Units (GRU) to forecast energy magnitude (keV). Our methodology includes hyper-parameter tuning and use of custom weighted loss function to enhance model accuracy and performance to 88.36%. The datasets used in the study is taken from SHARP summary parameters obtained form vector magnetograms captured by the HMI on the Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO). This study consists of two modules, the first module is predicting solar flare energy magnitude and second module is to find study how these flare have impacts on temperature.

articleTitle: Privacy-Preserving Employee Attrition Prediction using Deep Learning and Fully Homomorphic Encryption
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Employee attrition presents a significant challenge for organizations, impacting both finances and operations. Mean-while, the automation of human resource processes, including recruitment and performance monitoring, heavily relies on vast amounts of personal data. Traditional predictive models for employee attrition have increasingly turned to deep learning techniques due to their superior accuracy in deciphering complex data patterns. However, these methods raise serious privacy concerns due to their reliance on sensitive employee information. This paper introduces a novel solution by integrating Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) with deep learning, ensuring data privacy without compromising predictive performance. This integration not only enhances attrition prediction accuracy but also maintains employee data confidentiality, potentially improving organizational efficiency and trust in HR processes.

articleTitle: Borewell Rescue Operation Using Android Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The urgent need for effective rescue operations in the context of borewell accidents, where innocent lives, especially children, are at risk. These bore-wells are trapping a lot of innocent kids, who are dying as a result. While bore- wells are intended to save lives, they have instead started to take a great number of innocent lives. Several times, large machines and a lot of human labor are used in the rescue efforts. These rescue operations are typically very drawn-out, difficult, and time- consuming processes. Conventional rescue methods involving excavation are slow, labor-intensive, and hazardous. In response to this challenge, the report proposes an innovative approach to borewell rescue operations. This method employs a mechanical apparatus equipped with a gripper arm, which navigates through the borewell channel under the control of a microcontroller. Introduces a novel approach to borewell rescue operations utilizing Android applications. The traditional methods of rescue involving excavation are often slow, laborious, and risky. This paper proposes an innovative solution leveraging Android technology to streamline and enhance the rescue process. The system employs an Android application that communicates with a mechanical apparatus equipped with a gripper arm, designed to navigate through the borewell channel. Through the application interface, rescue personnel can remotely control the movement and operation of the apparatus, optimizing the rescue efforts. This integration of Android technology aims to expedite rescue operations, minimize risks, and ultimately save lives more efficiently in borewell emergencies.

articleTitle: Analysis of Artificial Intelligence Techniques on Sustainable Employee Performance Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Sustainable employee performance management (EPM) models are key to achieving the SDGs such as Promoting decent work and economic growth, reducing inequality, ensuring quality education, promoting gender equality, fostering innovation, sustainable practices like Green Human Resource Management, and Building Partnerships in work environments. Such performance management models would require data-driven insights to arrive at the right decisions in recruiting, assessing, rewarding, ensuring good employee health, and retaining employees for strategic advantages to institutions and countries alike. AI technologies could be employed for effective employee performance management with checks and balances as they have immense learning and predictive potential to avoid human errors and biases. This work presents EPM elements, an analysis of the EPM framework, EPM measurement techniques using AI techniques, Metrics for EPM, and finally, the future direction of research.

articleTitle: Optimizing Vanet Communications: A Bibliometric Analysis of Energy-Efficient Strategies with Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks (VANETs) are important for intelligent transportation systems, permitting vehicles to communicate with one another and nearby infrastructure in order to enhance road safety, traffic management and infotainment services. But the VANET communication is a high energy consumption technology, which may become a big challenge of large-scale power efficiency being in some real scenarios where huge number vehicles are needed to implement such V2I or V2V services sustaining. This paper conducts a analysis of different transmission stratagems for energy-efficient communication strategies among vehicles in VANETs, along with the focus to incorporate deep learning accelerators into an optimized architecture framework for enhancing communication processes. The paper presents an overview of VANET architecture and communication protocols, and then reviews the techniques to save energy in a VANET including efficient mechanisms for Transmission Power Control (TPC), some energy-aware routing protocols, as well as data aggregation realizations. Next, the paper introduces deep learning models that can adaptively optimize VANET transmission by forecasting network states and updating strategies on-the-fly. This analysis emphasizes hybrid solutions where deep learning is combined with traditional communication strategies to improve the energy efficiency apparent on a system level. Finally addresses the current challenges in the field and the need for advanced AI-driven techniques. This bibliometric analysis provides a comprehensive overview of energy-efficient communication strategies in VANETs, offering insights into how deep learning can contribute to the development of more sustainable vehicular networks.

articleTitle: Developed Hybrid Self-Organizing Map, Weighed Quantum Particle Swarm Optimization with Improved K-Means Clustering for Document Clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Computational Intelligence (CI) is a computational methodology inspired by nature that includes strategies and techniques for addressing complex problems by adapting to changing environments. CI approaches encompass hybrid paradigms such as artificial machine learning, fuzzy systems, swarm intelligence, and evolutionary computation. The aim of clustering is to group a collection of items into subsets or clusters that are internally consistent while being significantly different from one another. Document or text clustering refers to the process of organizing a set of written materials into clusters such that the documents within each cluster share similar characteristics in different clusters are distinct. For document clustering, a hybrid approach combining Self-Organizing Map, Weighted Quantum Particle Swarm Optimization, and Improved K-Means Clustering (SWI) is proposed. The proposed hybrid method consists of three stages. In the first stage, SOM is used to generate prototype matrices. In the second stage, WQPSO is employed to identify the initial centroids for K-Means. Finally, in the third stage, the K-Means clustering algorithm organizes the preliminary vector representations into clusters. This method addresses some of the limitations of existing K-Means, including its sensitivity to initial cluster center placements, its struggles with clustering high-dimensional data, and its tendency to converge to local minima. The performance of the proposed clustering technique is compared with other methods, the word frequency-based hybrid SWI approach for clustering vectors generated from sense-labeled texts.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Perception of Color Casting and Contrasting in Underwater Image using Fusion Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: A thorough method for improving color casting and contrast perception in underwater images is described, coupled with a compression and reconstruction technique to maintain the enhanced visual quality of the images while reducing storage and transmission costs. The suggested approach combines color correction and image enhancement techniques, followed by a robust compression algorithm leverages the underlying statistical properties of the enhanced image. The reconstruction process subsequently recovers the high-quality image using a decompression technique. Both subjective and objective image quality measures are used to assess the effectiveness of the suggested strategy, showing notable gains in visual perception and compression efficiency. The outcomes show that the suggested strategy has the potential to enable more efficient underwater data analysis and interpretation.

articleTitle: Computer Vision Based Enhanced Traffic Management System Using YOLO
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Traffic congestion is deteriorating day by day. The traditional traditional traffic signals cannot deal with the ever- increasing number of vehicles appropriately. We have combined computer vision and machine learning to replicate the complicated inflow and outflow of traffic in signalized crossings. You Only Look Once (YOLO) is a state- of- the- art object identification system based on deep convolutional neural network, which we have used in this context. This research proposes the need to implement this method properly to maximize the number of cars that may safely cross while minimizing waiting time. In this method, the traffic signal phase is mostly determined by the collected data which includes waiting time per vehicle and congestion density. YOLO can be implemented using transfer learning algorithms in the embedded controllers. Vehicle counting is the estimation of traffic density for estimating traffic conditions. With their extensive use in urban traffic, video surveillance today forms an integral part of the Central data source. Recently, real- time traffic management systems have been developed using handheld and mobile cameras and big data processing. Here we propose a vehicle counting approach based on video frames captured by a handheld traffic camera. The video processing is divided into three steps: object recognition using YOLO, tracking using a correlation filter, and finally counting. Regarding the number of persons, the findings from the correlation and YOLO filters are extremely accurate. For example, correlation filters are utilized to attain improved accuracy and comparable tracking speed, even if the YOLO model performs better in detection than the others. Therefore, a multi- object tracker based on correlation filters is constructed using the YOLO model's result bounding boxes. Empirical research using real- world video recordings demonstrates that the suggested approach is capable of detecting, tracking, and measuring moving vehicles.

articleTitle: Enhanced Skin Cancer Diagnosis via Optimized ResNet150v2-CNN Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Precise classification and detection of skin lesions are critical for enabling timely diagnoses and effective treatments. This project leverages the comprehensive HAM10000 dataset, which features a wide range of annotated skin lesion images, to develop an innovative hybrid model for lesion classification. By integrating convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with traditional machine learning techniques, alongside sophisticated data augmentation strategies, we enhance model robustness and accuracy while mitigating overfitting issues. Our approach emphasizes transfer learning to exploit pretrained networks, facilitating more effective feature extraction from complex visual patterns within the dataset. Comprehensive evaluation metrics which includes specificity, sensitivity, precision, accuracy and F1-score, reveal that Hybrid-Model significantly outperforms traditional methods, achieving 97% of accuracy and 97.23% of F-Score. In dermatology, this research not only advances automated skin lesion analysis but also highlights the transformative potential of artificial intelligence in dermatology. Ultimately, our findings aim to enhance diagnostic accuracy, thereby promoting early skin cancer detection and fostering personalized patient care pathways.

articleTitle: Smart Pen Utilizing IoT for Detection of Concentration Lapses During Writing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has reshaped vital sectors like education and productivity by enabling real-time data collecting and analysis. This paper describes a smart pen meant to detect attention drifts and concentration lapses during writing jobs, which uses IoT technologies to improve real-time focus detection. The smart pen is fitted with a variety of sensors, including an accelerometer, gyroscope, and pressure sensor, which monitor the user's writing behaviors and style while delivering statistics on concentration levels. This data is evaluated using sophisticated algorithms to detect instances of cognitive stray. The smart pen contains a companion app called the Blynk app that employs wireless connectivity to perform graphical analysis of writing patterns, alerting users when inattentive and providing real-time feedback to help them restore focus. Initially, the smart pen can effectively help users regain lost concentration, resulting in increased productivity and discipline in learning contexts. This cognitive alert pen improves concentration, creativity, and productivity in educational environments. Such an attention drift detection tool not only gives rapid feedback, but it also evaluates performance, promoting a more disciplined and focused learning environment.

articleTitle: Plant Disease Detection System Using Convolutional Neural Networks and TensorFlow Lite
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This research paper presents a comprehensive, intelligent system for detecting plant diseases using deep learning models. The system's novelty lies in its ability to automatically retrain itself when sufficient new data is gathered, allowing for continuous model improvement without manual intervention. Unclassified plant images are routed to an “unknown” category, where domain experts can manually label them. The retraining process is triggered once a threshold number of images are labelled, ensuring the model can learn from real-world data continuously. The system utilizes a backend developed with Flask and a frontend using Next.js 14 and Tailwind CSS for an intuitive user experience. Additionally, secure APIs are implemented to ensure that only authenticated administrators have access to manage the system and the unclassified images. Over several retraining cycles, the system demonstrated improved accuracy and adaptability, addressing critical challenges in plant disease detection and classification in real-world applications.

articleTitle: IoT-Enabled Secure Energy Management System in Smart Meters with CRFN: A Novel Approach to Billing and Theft Prevention
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In response to the challenges posed by missed electricity bill payments and unauthorized power consumption, this study introduces enhancements to existing smart energy meter systems. The proposed improvements include the integration of advanced security features and automation capabilities, such as refined theft control mechanisms and optimized communication protocols between energy providers and consumers. Leveraging IoT technology, the system enables real-time energy monitoring, automatic billing, and timely payment reminders via SMS. Additionally, innovative theft prevention measures, including automated power disconnection for overdue accounts and theft detection systems, bolster security and reduce losses. The integration of the Convolutive Recurrent Fusion Network (CRFN) algorithm significantly enhances the system's theft detection and prevention capabilities. The CRFN detects anomalies in power consumption that may indicate theft, such as sudden spikes or drops in usage, through advanced pattern recognition. Upon detecting potential theft, the system can trigger automated responses like alerts or power disconnection, reducing the need for manual intervention. The incorporation of a magnetic reed switch further enhances efficiency by automatically controlling power access for consumers who have not paid their bills by the due date. By addressing these challenges and integrating advancements, the proposed framework aims to create a more efficient, secure, and sustainable energy management solution, ensuring accurate billing, preventing unauthorized usage, and promoting environmental responsibility.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Cervical Cancer Detection Using Hunter Prey Optimizer Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Deep learning (DL) is a widely employed technique in many different sectors these days, including medicine. Many problems that may be difficult to solve with traditional synthetic intelligence (AI) strategies can be solved with DL strategies. With more than seven hundred deaths each day, cervical cancer (CC) is the second leading cause of death in women after cancer. By 2030, this number is projected to reach 400,000 each year. Nonetheless, cancer is entirely treatable if it is discovered in its early and precancerous phases. The two most well-known screening strategies for identifying cervical cancer are the Pap smear and colposcopy. but the manual screening technique has a high error rate due to human error. In order to get around this obstacle, machine learning. Nowadays, deep studying (DL) is a method this is broadly used in many other fields, consisting of medication. DL techniques may handle a wide range of problems that are difficult to solve with traditional artificial intelligence (AI) methods. Cervical cancer (CC) is the second most common cause of death for women, after breast cancer, accounting for about 700 deaths every day. This number is expected to increase to 400,000 annually by 2030. However, if cancer is detected in its early and precancerous stages, it is completely curable. Pap tests and colposcopies are the two most widely used screening methods for the detection of cervical cancer. However, due to human error, the manual screening process has a high false rate win over this project, machine learning. The proposed model achieved 97.8% ACC, 95.4% Spec, 95.7% Recall, 98.2% Prec, and 97.6% F1-Score.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Trust Inference Theory to Optimizing Multi-Level Trust in Software Defined Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In the evolving landscape of Software Defined Networks (SDNs) and Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs), ensuring secure and reliable communication is paramount, particularly in the presence of potential malicious nodes and denial-of-service (DoS) attacks. This paper proposes a novel model named Probabilistic Trust Inference Theory (PTIT) for optimizing multi-level trust management with Enhanced Lion Optimization (ELO) for routing. Our model incorporates a dynamic trust evaluation framework that leverages both direct and indirect interactions to compute trust scores through a Bayesian inference mechanism. By establishing multiple trust levels, we enhance the granularity of trust assessments, facilitating the formation of robust trust-based clusters that mitigate the risk of attacks. Each cluster is led by a high-trust node, ensuring reliable data aggregation and communication pathways. The proposed routing protocol employs ELO to integrate trust considerations into path selection, significantly reducing the likelihood of routing through untrustworthy nodes while defending against malicious activities and DoS attacks. We evaluate the performance of our approach through extensive simulations, demonstrating substantial improvements in network throughput, latency, and energy efficiency compared to existing trust management frameworks. Our findings highlight the effectiveness of PTIT-ELO in creating a resilient and adaptive trust management system that enhances the security and reliability of WSNs against malicious threats. This work contributes to the growing body of research aimed at fortifying network infrastructures while optimizing overall performance.

articleTitle: Paper Securing and Safeguarding Multimedia Privacy in the Internet Of Multimedia Things (IoMT)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Among the evolution of the Internet of Multimedia Things (IoMT), ensuring multimedia privacy is a significant area of concern. This study focuses on IoMT -based multimedia privacy, due to its importance in today's connected world. The data involved in multimedia applications of the IoMT are pictures, audio, and video, which are on the rise from healthcare to smart cities, necessitating its safety as a paramount issue. The research seeks to establish and analyze inherent vulnerabilities in the IoMT that lead to threats against multimedia privacy and ultimately develop an integrated system that will help protect and secure such information effectively. Drawing on the mixed methods design, this study uses a mixture of quantitative and qualitative analysis to explore the state of multimedia privacy within IoMT. Specifically, it entails the evaluation of security protocols currently in place, privacy-preserving algorithms, as well as legal and regulatory frameworks on multimedia data. Additionally, through case studies and expert interviews, this research delves into practical problems and solutions. Among the outcomes identified is the need for improved versions of privacy control models capable of reflecting different organizational environment features, the dynamic nature of threats, and untrusted insider action patterns associated with that. A number of steps are suggested by the research, such as the creation of advanced encryption algorithms, greater public consciousness, and regulatory policies. The goal of these recommendations is to create a safe multimedia space for IoMT where privacy is observed as an empowerment of users and stakeholders, not just for protection. The study findings are particularly meaningful in terms of multimedia privacy rhetoric with their strategic plan, which provides a logical pattern for stakeholders to navigate through the maze of IoMT issues while providing for multimedia data privacy and security.

articleTitle: Deep Learning with 3D CNN for Knee Osteoarthritis Detection and Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Of all joints, the knee is the most commonly afflicted with osteoarthritis (OA), which is the most common form of arthritis. Even though CNNs are seriously being utilized in medical imaging, 3D CNNs are yet to be applied as a standard for diagnosing knee OA. In this, the 3D CNN model was applied on the knee MRI sequences to classify the presence of osteoarthritis (OA). Probably the strongest point of 3D CNNs over 2D CNNs is that 3D CNNs can process the whole MRI sequence in one go, while 2D CNNs can only analyze a single photograph. In this, the KL grading ranking the intensity of OA from 0 to 4 was used for each one of the knees based on MRI data taken. The result showed that the 3D CNN model could differentiate the OA and non-OA knees well both in test and validation phases. Another model used for comparison is a 2D CNN model that uses X-ray images. Although much less accurate than the 3D CNN on MRI data, this model was also able to be used quite well. Thus, the diagnosis of knee OA is much more accurate by the method combining MRI and 3D CNN technology as compared to just with X-ray imaging, although both of these models have some clinical values. The work concludes by depicting how 3D CNN can be useful in the detection of OA through complex sequences of MRI images compared to traditional 2D methods.

articleTitle: Enhancing Eye Health Diagnosis through Deep Transfer Learning: Unveiling Insights from Low Quality Fundus Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Due to the frequency of eye illnesses, effective and precise diagnostic instruments are required. This work suggests an approach that uses low quality fundus images with deep transfer learning more precisely, the EfficientNetB0 architecture to improve eye health diagnosis. We tackle the problem caused by the quality of fundus photographs that are commonly found in clinical settings, which frequently display noise and abnormalities. Our methodology consists of pretraining the EfficientNetB0 model on a sizable dataset of excellent fundus photos, followed by fine-tuning it on a dataset of poor fundus photos. By employing this transfer learning technique, the model enhances its diagnostic capabilities by learning to identify significant features from the low-quality images. We ran tests on a variety of datasets that included fundus photos of varying degrees of deterioration in order to assess our approach. As compared to conventional techniques, the results reveal a significant improvement in diagnostic accuracy, demonstrating the effectiveness of deep transfer learning for improving eye health diagnosis from difficult fundus images. With fused features from MobileNet and DenseNet-121 models, the ANN specifically achieved accuracies of 98.5% for cataracts, 99.1% for diabetic retinopathy, 99% for glaucoma, and 99.5% for normal conditions.

articleTitle: Secured Framework for Vehicle Management Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: For many years, there were many different ways to arrange a vehicle's information using just the license plate. The number on a vehicle's license plate is the primary symbol used to identify it. The industries used to reciprocate the number plates in order to further uphold their basic standards. Anonymization through encryption is the preferred privacy setting for a license plate. We will have access to all the services required for faultless data maintenance through the Vehicle Management system. The entire system depends on the data, which is technologically encrypted and decrypted. However, data stored on a chip will be more secure than image recognition. It reduces the likelihood of mistakes and misunderstandings of the required information. Vehicle-related data is stored in a decentralized system. The suggested system either retrieves data from the smart number plate or uses an image processing technique to determine the license plate number through edge detection. The required data can be seen with this number. In order to ensure security, these data are encrypted using the SHA-256 algorithm and stored in a decentralized system using the Hyperledger Sawtooth framework, which also employs the PoET and BFT algorithms.

articleTitle: Enhanced QR CODE Scanning and Blockchain Technology for Drug Packaging System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Scanning a QR code on pharmaceutical packaging discloses essential information such as the medication's name, batch number, expiration date, and manufacturing date. This connectivity, together with blockchain technology, guarantees both accessibility and security of the data. The objective is to provide an intuitive system that provides straightforward access to pharmaceutical information, facilitating informed decision-making in healthcare. The inclusion of QR codes on drug packaging facilitates access to essential information, including the medicine's name, batch number, expiry date, and manufacturing date. This novel method improves accessibility while also strengthening data security. The incorporation of blockchain technology enhances the system's integrity by utilizing the hashing idea to guarantee data tamper resistance. This increased security mechanism enables users to accurately track the progression of a tablet sheet from its original manufacturing phase to its final distribution stage. This comprehensive solution offers an intuitive platform for accessing medication information while enabling users to make informed healthcare decisions, hence fostering transparency and accountability within the pharmaceutical supply chain. Keywords: Blockchain, Medical Record, QR Code, Dataset.

articleTitle: Exploring Large Scale Docker Image Vulnerability and Storage Performance Analysis Using High Performance Container-Based Docker Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In modern cloud environments, Docker containers have become a cornerstone for efficient application deployment, enabling microservices architectures and seamless scalability. However, large-scale Docker environments present significant challenges, particularly in terms of security vulnerabilities and storage performance. This paper explores vulnerability analysis and storage performance optimization in high-performance, container-based Docker environments. Docker swarm is a container orchestration platform which could be very useful for maintaining the docker containers at scale even at distributed environment, these tools also provide us a great features for managing the rolling updates and health check in the lifecycle of containers. We perform a comprehensive evaluation of Docker image vulnerabilities using automated scanning tools, assessing common vulnerabilities and exposures (CVEs) across large image repositories. Additionally, we investigate storage performance bottlenecks and analyse the impact of various storage drivers on container efficiency. Our findings offer critical insights into balancing performance and security in high-scale Docker deployments, proposing strategies for mitigating risks and enhancing resource management. The results guide container orchestration decisions for enterprises aiming to deploy secure, high-performance systems.

articleTitle: Attendance Management System using Haar Cascades and MTCNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: A cloud-based attendance management system utilizing advanced facial recognition algorithms to enhance efficiency and accuracy in educational environments. By employing the CASIA WebFace dataset, which features a diverse collection of facial images, the system leverages deep learning techniques to extract meaningful features and identify individuals effectively. The process begins with image acquisition via webcams or mobile devices, followed by preprocessing to improve image quality. Face detection is accomplished using Haar Cascades, a swift method for identifying facial regions in real-time. Once detected, facial features are extracted using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), which are designed to learn and classify complex patterns inherent in facial data. These extracted features are then compared against a centralized database, allowing for real-time updates to attendance records. The cloud infrastructure supports the processing of large datasets efficiently, ensuring rapid and accurate attendance tracking. This architecture enhances scalability, making it adaptable to various classroom sizes and environments. The findings demonstrate notable improvements in both accuracy and processing speed for attendance monitoring, highlighting the transformative potential of automated facial recognition systems in modern educational settings. This research contributes to the ongoing evolution of intelligent solutions, paving the way for streamlined attendance management practices.

articleTitle: Real-Time Sentiment Mining: Aspect-Based and Implicit Opinion Extraction in Social Media Posts
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In today's digital landscape, social media platforms serve as a major source of public opinion and feedback on a wide array of topics, from products to social issues. However, extracting meaningful insights from this data is challenging due to the unstructured nature of social media text, where sentiments are often implicit and context-dependent. This study presents a novel approach for real-time aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) and implicit opinion extraction tailored to social media data. Using a comprehensive dataset derived from Twitter and other popular social networks, we develop a model that identifies and categorizes specific aspects of discussion and extracts sentiments that are both explicitly stated and implied within the text. This approach leverages natural language processing techniques, including transformerbased models, to address the complexities of short, informal, and often ambiguous posts. The model is designed to operate in real time, enabling the timely detection of emerging trends and shifts in public sentiment. Experiments demonstrate that this model achieves high accuracy in recognizing sentiment-laden aspects and implicit opinions across diverse domains. The findings reveal valuable insights into user sentiments that are not overtly expressed, providing a deeper understanding of social media data for applications in business, policy, and customer feedback. Our research contributes to the growing field of ABSA by expanding sentiment analysis to include nuanced, implicit sentiment extraction, thereby enhancing real-time monitoring and decision- making processes.

articleTitle: Smart Travel Solutions Harnessing Artificial Intelligence for Optimal Route Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This AI-based route optimizing system has put its focal point on only efficient travel routes based on real-time traffic. It focuses on calculating the shortest distance to source, along with destination and via points, distance, time-based traffic details, in order to arrive at the most optimal route for any journey. Advanced AI techniques in optimizing systems continuously adjust the route according to live traffic patterns so that users may experience the least delay possible. The system integrates with fuel consumption estimations provided the traveler through inputting vehicle mileage, enabling travelers to make better plans for their trips by considering time and fuel efficiency. This would save one time spent traveling, saves fuel, thus saving money while keeping the environment free from pollution. By such smart decisions on making routes, the system increases drivers' overall driving experience, especially in crowded areas or where there is heavy traffic. Since the system is inherently real-time, it's therefore very adaptive to the changing nature of road conditions, thus travel stream lined for the users.

articleTitle: Enhancing Patient Care Through NLP-Based Realtime Bidirectional Voice Translation in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In healthcare settings, the language barrier between patients and medical professionals poses a significant challenge, impacting the quality of care and patient outcomes. Patients that struggle with language barriers to properly connect with their healthcare providers may face obstacles in receiving timely and accurate treatment. The proposed solution leverages bidirectional voice translation capabilities to facilitate communication between individuals who do not share a common language. This research introduces bidirectional voice translation technology as a solution to the language barrier in healthcare. Through the application of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Speech Recognition algorithms, this mobile application enables real-time translation of spoken input between patients and medical professionals. By employing a mobile application accessible to both medical professionals and patients, this technology enables seamless communication in diverse linguistic settings. This innovation enhances communication, enabling accurate diagnosis, treatment, and explanation of medical procedures across diverse linguistic backgrounds. With multilingual support, sentiment analysis, and offline capabilities, this technology offers a promising avenue to improve patient care, health outcomes, and inclusivity in healthcare delivery.

articleTitle: Intelligent SSH Attack Detection Model Using K-Clique Clustering and Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The research aims at developing a system that applies graph-based clustering of log data-more specifically, k-clique percolation to detect and analyze SSH brute-force attacks. The process involves preprocessing SSH data, constructing an IP interaction network graph, and then applying clustering algorithms to identify patterns that are indicative of malicious behavior. Furthermore, integration of a reinforcement learning model, specifically the q-learning algorithm, with cyber security will strengthen the system's predictive abilities and enable it to adapt continually to new attack vectors. The aim is to develop a powerful tool for tracking, evaluating, and preventing SSH brute-force attacks.

articleTitle: Mutual Clustering Coefficient-Based Suspicious-Link Detection Enhancing Sentiment Analysis in Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The exponential growth of social networks has led to the proliferation of misleading, malicious, or suspicious content, significantly impacting user interactions and societal perceptions. To address these challenges, this study proposes a Mutual Clustering Coefficient (MCC) based Suspicious-Link Detection model, which enhances sentiment analysis in social networks. The model leverages MCC to detect suspicious links that could influence the spread of false or harmful information. By analyzing the relationships between users and the density of connections within clusters, the model identifies anomalies that deviate from normal user interactions, thereby flagging suspicious links. Additionally, the model incorporates sentiment analysis to evaluate the emotional tone of interactions surrounding these links. This dual approach analyzing both network structure and sentiment provides a comprehensive method for early detection of harmful content. The proposed system is validated using large-scale Online Social Network (OSN) datasets, demonstrating high accuracy in detecting suspicious links while enhancing the precision of sentiment analysis. By integrating both MCC and sentiment analysis, this research aims to improve the safety, trustworthiness, and overall health of social network platforms,

articleTitle: OptiX-CatBoost: An Optimized Explainable CatBoost Model for Analyzing the Effects of Health-Related Factors on Obesity
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Obesity is a significant health concern linked to severe medical conditions. Obesity increases the risk of diabetes, thyroid issues, cardiac disease, liver tumors, and stroke. Early prediction of obesity risk is essential for improving public health and well-being. To address this, an optimized explain-able CatBoost model, referred to as OptiX-CatBoost, has been developed. Initially, various machine learning (ML) models are trained using the publicly available dhaka obesity dataset. Among these, the categorical boosting (CatBoost) model emerged as the top performer and is selected for optimization. Bayesian optimization is employed to fine-tune key hyperparameters of the CatBoost model, enhancing its performance. The experimental results demonstrated that the OptiX-CatBoost model outperformed existing methods, achieving an accuracy of 95.60%, a precision of 94.60%, a recall of 93.12%, an F1-score of 98.15%, a Jaccard score of 96.14%, and a Kappa score of 87.14%. Additionally, the predictions made by the proposed model are further analyzed using explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) techniques. Healthcare professionals can evaluate the predictions of the proposed model and learn more about the different factors driving obesity by using XAI techniques such as partial dependence graphs, permutation significance, and LIME (Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations). This dual capability of accurate prediction and interpretability renders OptiX-CatBoost a valuable tool for early obesity risk assessment, ultimately aiding in the development of better public health strategies and interventions.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Career Guidance and Aptitude Testing for Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Without career counselling or testing, selecting a career can result in a host of problems, such as mismatched interests and talents, inflated expectations, a lack of vocational knowledge, misaligned goals, insufficient preparation, unstable finances, stress on an individual basis, and a poor work-life balance. Through the provision of insightful advice, organized preparation, and well-informed decision-making support, career guidance helps to reduce these risks. The proposed work, which uses AI and machine learning to improve existing processes, will revolutionize students' access to aptitude testing and career coaching in secondary schools. The system gathers and assesses a variety of data, including grades, extracurricular activity, and personal interests, before producing personalized career advice. Machine learning algorithms suggest personalized suggestions based on the user's interest and knowledge. Students can submit their data with ease, and the feedback loop ensures that it is always relevant. The information gathered will help governments and schools, and students to make educated career decisions. All things considered, the program transforms secondary education by giving students the resources they require to pursue and land fulfilling careers.

articleTitle: OptiX-AI-RF: An Optimized AI-Enhanced Explainable Random Forest Model for Fault Detection in Streetlight Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Streetlights are crucial for public safety, especially for those traveling at night. Unfortunately, many areas encounter non-functioning streetlights due to various issues, which can lead to significant safety hazards. To address this problem, an optimized artificial intelligence (AI)-enhanced explainable Random Forest model, referred to as OptiX-AI-RF, has been developed for fault detection in streetlight systems. Initially, various machine learning (ML) models are trained using publicly available street light fault prediction dataset. Since the random forest (RF) model outperformed the others, it is utilized for optimization. Key RF model hyperparameters are adjusted using Bayesian optimization to improve the detection capabilities of the model. The experimental results demonstrated that the OptiX-AI-RF model effectively identified faults in streetlight systems, achieving an accuracy of 82.88%, a precision of 86.30%, a recall of 82.88%, and an F1-score of 78.98%. The predictions of the suggested model are further analyzed using explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) methods. OptiX-AI-RF enables authorities to evaluate the predictions of the model and gain insights into the various factors contributing to streetlight failures by utilizing XAI techniques such as permutation importance, partial dependence plots, and LIME (Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations). This dual capability of accurate fault detection and explainability makes OptiX-AI-RF a valuable tool for maintaining streetlight infrastructure, ultimately aiding in the implementation of more effective maintenance strategies and enhancing public safety in urban areas.

articleTitle: A Compact Orthogonal Dual Element MIMO Antenna for K, Ka-Band and mmWave Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel design and optimization approach for a compact K-band Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO) antenna, catering to the requirements of high-speed wireless communication systems. It addresses challenges like compactness, high gain, and mutual coupling effects in MIMO setups by utilizing advanced simulation techniques and optimization algorithms. Through analyzing frequency needs and radiation characteristics, it explores various antenna configurations and feed network architectures. The focus is on achieving compactness, efficient power distribution, and impedance matching while evaluating metrics like radiation pattern, impedance bandwidth, envelope correlation coefficient (ECC), and diversity gain. The resulting design is optimized for integration into diverse high-speed wireless communication systems like 5G networks, satellite communication, radar systems, and wireless backhaul links, offering valuable insights for researchers and engineers in the field.

articleTitle: AI-Based Detection and Analysis of Phishing Domains: Leveraging Machine Learning for Enhanced Cybersecurity
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In the ever-evolving landscape of cyber security, the prevalence of phishing attacks poses a formidable threat to information security systems worldwide, compromising data integrity and eroding user trust. This paper introduces an innovative solution harnessing artificial intelligence to identify and analyze phishing domains, particularly focusing on newly registered domains from public databases like WHOIS. This approach is crucial as traditional security measures often prove insufficient against the sophistication of phishing tactics. Our proposed AI-driven system employs an analysis strategy. It utilizes machine learning to conduct an in-depth backend code and content analysis. This involves comparing suspect and legitimate sites for structural and syntactical disparities, utilizing deep learning models trained on extensive datasets of known phishing and authentic domains. These methodologies offer a nuanced evaluation, crucial for distinguishing sophisticated phishing attempts from genuine domains. Additionally, the system excels at identifying malicious links within these domains, enhancing its overall protective capabilities. The efficiency of our solution lies in its capacity for real-time, accurate threat detection. We introduce a probabilistic scoring mechanism that assesses the likelihood of a domain being a phishing site, facilitating informed decision-making for cyber security personnel. Furthermore, our system is designed for seamless integration into existing cyber security frameworks, providing versatility and ease of use.

articleTitle: Automatic Brain Tumor Detection Classification Applying Multiple a Deep Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Automated detection of defects in medical imaging has emerged as a crucial domain within various diagnostic applications, especially with MRI regarding tumor detection. “While accuracy in the detection of tumors is important in providing vital information regarding tissues which have deviated from their normal state, it's even more important for effective treatment planning”. Currently, the diagnosis of tumors from brain MRI scans relies on human assessment, which is infeasible for large image data and error-prone based on judgments of humans. Thus, there is a pressing need for robust and efficient automated classification systems that can overcome these bottlenecks. The core idea of our project is the development of the most advanced tumor detection methods, which saves precious time for radiologists but at a very high accuracy and, thus, reduces mortality levels in patients. In our approach, we have used several CNNs - VGG19, ResNet50, and MobileNetV2, which we have applied through transfer learning for detecting tumors from brain MRIs. We also incorporate into our model an ensemble of these varied CNN architectures that leverages their strengths since the nature and diversity of tumors are intricate. In fact, the ensemble method is really intended to boost the wide-ranging accuracy and strength of the procedure in the detection of tumors. The proposed system utilizes deep learning techniques in combination with image classification to accurately and efficiently identify cancerous cells in brain MRI scans. After that, the web application, developed using Flask, will provide a user-friendly interface for uploading MRI images and then instantaneously return predictions to a doctor on the potential presence of a tumor.

articleTitle: Routing Selection and Routing Scheme for IoT Beyond 5G (B5G) Network Using Dispersed Path Selection for Communication and Multi-Criteria
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The inconsistency of mobile nodes within the network makes single-pass communication unsatisfactory. Should a different course be followed, the communication system would be unable to manage the increased workload. Packet loss is unpredictable when mobile nodes have poor connectivity. In this network, path linkages are not monitored. One of the most exciting developments in B5G (beyond fifth generation) wireless networks is device-to-device (D2D) communication. In addition, communication expenditures are concentrated on obtaining effective packet forwarding. This is a result of the increased communication costs associated with the long-distance networks selected for packet transmission. Both packet loss and energy usage rise. In order to achieve the best minimal distance routing path, the suggested path selection communication (DPAC) approach is set up to use queue modifications, which manage the maintenance of packets and slots that are above their allotted limitations. The message keeps waiting in an effort to increase message broadcasting efficiency. In order to detect packet overload, the multipath interference detection method is set up to offer a link-based routing packet overload detection system. To solve these significant issues, an MBMQA (Mobility, Battery and Queue Length Multipath Awareness) routing strategy based on D2D communication is also available for IoT B5G networks. Comprehensive simulation findings at different device speeds show that MBLCR outperforms traditional methods in terms of energy efficiency, latency, packet transfer rate, throughput, and latency.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Optimization of Electrolysis Parameters in Green Hydrogen Production
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: An investigation of the functioning of machine literacy methods to optimize electrolysis settings for the production of green hydrogen is presented in this research. It is of the utmost importance to improve the efficiency of green hydrogen products as the globe moves toward more sustainable energy results.
